data.title: KOMMENTAR - Keine Gnade für Jihadisten – aber ein faires Verfahren
data.description: Sie zogen nach Syrien und in den Irak, um sich dem IS anzuschliessen. Nun wollen 25 französische Terroristen zurück nach Frankreich – und ausgerechnet der Europäische Gerichtshof für Menschenrechte soll ihnen dabei helfen. Das ist schwer erträglich, aber ihr gutes Recht.
data.translatedTitle: COMMENT - No mercy for jihadists – but a fair trial
data.translatedDescription: They moved to Syria and Iraq to join ISIS. Now 25 French terrorists want to return to France - and the European Court of Human Rights is supposed to help them. It's hard to bear, but it's your right.

data.title: Wieso so viele Ostdeutsche die AfD wählen und was das für Europa bedeutet
data.description: Der Erfolg der Rechten in Ostdeutschland speist sich aus der Erfahrung von Umbruch und Verlusten. Nur wer das versteht, kann auf die geopolitischen Auswirkungen reagieren.
data.translatedTitle: Why so many East Germans vote for the AfD and what that means for Europe
data.translatedDescription: The success of the right in East Germany is based on the experience of upheaval and loss. Only those who understand this can react to the geopolitical consequences.

data.title: In Liverpool erstarkt der Glaube an die «heilige Dreifaltigkeit» – dank neuem Trainer mit vertrauten Werten
data.description: Der Coach Andoni Iraola beschwört Gemeinschaft, Identität, Kollektiv beim englischen Fussballklub. Die Fans erreicht er damit. Zum Erfolg des mit teuren Stars gespickten Teams führt das bis jetzt aber nicht.
data.translatedTitle: In Liverpool, belief in the “holy trinity” is growing – thanks to a new coach with familiar values
data.translatedDescription: The coach Andoni Iraola invokes community, identity, collective at the English football club. This is how he reaches the fans. However, this has not yet led to the success of the team, which is full of expensive stars.

data.title: INTERVIEW - Die Schweizer Organisation Macroscopic Ventures wurde mit Anthropic reich – ihr Mitgründer sagt: «In einigen Jahren wird KI die physische Welt direkt beeinflussen»
data.description: Führende Vertreter der KI-Branche warnen vor den Gefahren ihrer Technologie. Macroscopic Ventures investiert Millionen in die Erforschung solcher Risiken. Jonas Vollmer sagt, warum er es für gefährlich hält, der KI immer mehr Kontrolle zu überlassen.
data.translatedTitle: INTERVIEW - The Swiss organization Macroscopic Ventures got rich with Anthropic - its co-founder says: "In a few years, AI will directly influence the physical world"
data.translatedDescription: AI industry leaders warn about the dangers of their technology. Macroscopic Ventures invests millions in researching such risks. Jonas Vollmer explains why he thinks it is dangerous to give AI more and more control.

data.title: Mehr Polizisten für Wien? Wer fünf Jahre bleibt, darf garantiert in Bundesländer wechseln
data.description: Das Innenministerium startet eine neue Recruiting-Initiative namens „Wien auf Zeit“. Nach fünf Jahren Hauptstadtdienst wird eine Versetzung in die Bundesländer garantiert. Von der in Wien gesammelten Erfahrung sollen alle profitieren – und die Versetzungswarteliste soll kürzer werden.
data.translatedTitle: More police officers for Vienna? Anyone who stays for five years is guaranteed to be allowed to move to federal states
data.translatedDescription: The Ministry of the Interior is launching a new recruiting initiative called “Temporary Vienna”. After five years of service in the capital, a transfer to the federal states is guaranteed. Everyone should benefit from the experience gained in Vienna - and the transfer waiting list should be shorter.

data.title: Bild um 30.000 Euro: Sobotka lässt sich von Erwin Wurm im Parlament verewigen

data.translatedTitle: Picture for 30,000 euros: Sobotka has Erwin Wurm immortalize him in parliament
data.translatedDescription: The former ÖVP parliamentary president had two sculptures erected in parliament for more than 200,000 euros. His FPÖ successor Walter Rosenkranz had the purchase reversed. Now Sobotka has his portrait portrayed by Wurm.

data.description: ÖVP, SPÖ und Neos einigen sich auf ein Klimagesetz „ohne Würgegriff“. Die Politik steht zur Abkehr von den Fossilen. Auch das in der Wirtschaft stark umstrittene 2040er-Ziel gibt es weiter. Allerdings nur auf dem Papier.

Die Anwältin Anna Mair, die sich als Vertreterin junger Islamisten einen Namen gemacht hat, meint, der Staat solle Plattformen wie TikTok stärker in die Pflicht nehmen.

data.title: Geht Putin jetzt aufs Ganze? In Russland warten alle nur darauf, was nach den Wahlen passiert
data.description: Die Duma-Wahl in Russland lässt die Russen eher kalt. Das Ergebnis steht quasi fest. An heiklen Themen wie dem Krieg in der Ukraine oder dem Benzinmangel will niemand anstreifen. „Presse“-Korrespondent Stefan Scholl erzählt von Begegnungen während des Wahlkampfs und wie es ist, als ausländischer Journalist in Moskau zu leben und zu arbeiten.
data.translatedTitle: Is Putin now going all out? In Russia everyone is just waiting to see what happens after the elections
data.translatedDescription: The Duma election in Russia leaves Russians rather cold. The result is almost certain. Nobody wants to touch on sensitive issues like the war in Ukraine or the shortage of gasoline. “Presse” correspondent Stefan Scholl talks about encounters during the election campaign and what it is like to live and work in Moscow as a foreign journalist.

data.translatedTitle: Donald Trump: My son paid back the wedding money to a Russian

data.description: W związku z atakiem rosyjskich dronów na cele na terenie Ukrainy Polska poderwała myśliwce. Dowództwo Operacyjne podało, że działania mają charakter prewencyjny.

data.translatedDescription: Due to the attack of Russian drones on targets in Ukraine, Poland scrambled fighters. The Operational Command stated that the actions were preventive in nature.

data.description: Mati Staniszewski i Piotr Dąbkowski negocjują kolejną rundę finansowania, celując w ponad pół miliarda dolarów. W gronie inwestorów ElevenLabs znalazł się Scaleup Europe Fund – unijny wehikuł o budżecie 5 mld euro.

data.translatedDescription: Mati Staniszewski and Piotr Dąbkowski are negotiating the next round of financing, targeting over half a billion dollars. ElevenLabs' investors include the Scaleup Europe Fund - an EU vehicle with a budget of EUR 5 billion.

data.title: Łukasz Jasina: Niemcy w końcu porozumieją się z Rosją. Idzie reset
data.description: Unia Europejska to jest jedyna instytucja, która nas ratuje przed dominacją niemiecką. Na razie w Niemczech, przy całym niezbyt dobrym stosunku do Polski, elity jednak doskonale wiedzą, że nie mogą sobie na pewne działania pozwolić – mówi Łukasz Jasina, były rzecznik prasowy MSZ, historyk i ekspert ds. międzynarodowych.
data.translatedTitle: Łukasz Jasina: Germany will finally reach an agreement with Russia. Reset is coming
data.translatedDescription: The European Union is the only institution that saves us from German domination. For now, in Germany, despite the not very good attitude towards Poland, the elites know perfectly well that they cannot afford certain actions, says Łukasz Jasina, former spokesman for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, historian and international affairs expert.

data.title: Revolut szykuje rewolucję w podróżach. AI znajdzie wyjazd, zarezerwuje i zapłaci
data.description: Revolut pracuje nad agentem AI, który pozna preferencje użytkownika, znajdzie lot i hotel, dokona rezerwacji i zapłaci. Fintech wspólnie z Visą przetestował już prawdziwą transakcję zainicjowaną przez sztuczną inteligencję. To może być początek dużej zmiany na rynku podróży i zakupów.
data.translatedTitle: Revolut is preparing a revolution in travel. AI will find a trip, book and pay
data.translatedDescription: Revolut is working on an AI agent that will learn user preferences, find a flight and hotel, make reservations and pay. Fintech, together with Visa, has already tested a real transaction initiated by artificial intelligence. This may be the beginning of a big change in the travel and shopping market.

data.title: Jak nie stracić na pozwie o zapłatę za kable, słupy czy gazociąg na działce
data.description: Właściciele nieruchomości coraz odważniej walczą o rekompensaty za korzystanie z ich gruntów w celu przesyłania energii elektrycznej, gazu itp. Nie wszyscy wiedzą, jakich kwot żądać od firmy przesyłowej, aby oczekiwań nie zjadły koszty procesu.
data.translatedTitle: How not to lose out on a lawsuit for payment for cables, poles or a gas pipeline on a plot of land
data.translatedDescription: Property owners are fighting more and more boldly for compensation for the use of their land for the transmission of electricity, gas, etc. Not everyone knows what amounts to demand from the transmission company so that expectations are not undermined by the costs of the process.

data.description: Piramida absurdu, stojąca za pomysłem posłów prawicy, by zorganizować we Lwowie oficjalne obchody Narodowego Święta Niepodległości, w tym polski Marsz Niepodległości, sięga nieboskłonu i wpisuje się w przygotowywane na Kremlu scenariusze eskalacji napięcia pomiędzy Polską i Ukrainą.

data.title: Donald Trump ogłosił przełom ws. Grenlandii. „Spełnienie marzeń USA”

The agreement is to be valid indefinitely.

The competition takes place between the AW109 TrekkerM and the H145M. The Ministry of National Defense wants bidders to meet three additional conditions: production in Poland, joint purchase in the SAFE formula and closed deliveries by the end of 2030.

data.description: Choroby będące skutkiem wieloletniego nadużywania alkoholu mogą uniemożliwiać wykonywanie pracy. Osoby dotknięte takimi schorzeniami mogą ubiegać się o rentę. Samo uzależnienie nie wystarczy jednak do jej przyznania.
data.translatedTitle: Who can get alcohol pension? ZUS takes two things into account
data.translatedDescription: Diseases resulting from long-term alcohol abuse may prevent you from working. People suffering from such diseases can apply for a pension. However, addiction alone is not enough to grant it.

data.title: Niemcy wychodzące ze strefy euro? Ekspert: „To tęsknota za NRD”
data.description: Poparcie dla wspólnej waluty w Niemczech jest najwyższe w historii, zapowiedzi AfD o wyjściu ze strefy euro są ruchem populistycznym. Celują w wyborców ze wschodnich landów niechętnych polityce Berlina i Brukseli - mówi Rafał Szymanowski, ekspert Instytutu Zachodniego.
data.translatedTitle: Germany leaving the euro zone? Expert: "It's a longing for the GDR"
data.translatedDescription: Support for the common currency in Germany is the highest in history, and the AfD's announcements about leaving the euro zone are a populist move. They target voters from the eastern states who are reluctant to the policies of Berlin and Brussels, says Rafał Szymanowski, an expert at the Institute for Western Affairs.

data.title: Czytanie wyraźnie zmniejsza ryzyko demencji. Jest jeden ważny warunek
data.description: Naukowcy z Cambridge dowodzą, że czytanie dla przyjemności chroni mózg przed demencją. Nowa analiza pokazuje, że książki to potężne narzędzie neuroprotekcyjne – szczególnie jeśli czytamy je z autentycznej pasji. Regularna lektura poprawia pamięć, empatię i zdrowie psychiczne oraz zmniejsza ryzyko otępienia.
data.translatedTitle: Reading clearly reduces the risk of dementia. There is one important condition
data.translatedDescription: Scientists from Cambridge prove that reading for pleasure protects the brain against dementia. New analysis shows that books are a powerful neuroprotective tool - especially if we read them with genuine passion. Regular reading improves memory, empathy and mental health and reduces the risk of dementia.

data.title: Żubry: Zaniedbany symbol Polski. „Ich sąsiedztwo bywa niekomfortowe”
data.description: Giną na drogach i torach, a także z rąk kłusowników. Coraz częściej na szkody powodowane przez żubry narzekają polscy rolnicy. – Zwierzętom należy się miejsce do życia. Bez przyrody sobie nie poradzimy, ona bez nas tak – mówią eksperci.
data.translatedTitle: Bisons: A neglected symbol of Poland. "Their neighborhood can be uncomfortable"
data.translatedDescription: They die on roads and tracks, as well as at the hands of poachers. Polish farmers are increasingly complaining about the damage caused by bison. – Animals deserve a place to live. We cannot cope without nature, but it can cope without us - say experts.

data.title: Burian, Uprka i slavný Mucha. Do aukce jde pozůstalost nakladatele Plichty
data.description: Stojí hned u vchodu do malostranské galerie Jakuba Sluky. Mezi vystavenými obrazy a plastikami slavných umělců vypadá až nepatřičně. Stará, otřískaná kytara, které navíc chybějí struny. Ale i takhle může vypadat umění.
data.translatedTitle: Burian, Uprka and the famous Mucha. The estate of the publisher Plichta is going to the auction
data.translatedDescription: It stands right at the entrance to the Malostran gallery of Jakub Sluka. It looks out of place among the exhibited paintings and sculptures of famous artists. An old, chipped guitar with missing strings. But art can look like this too.

data.title: V Mnichově začíná Oktoberfest, litr piva bude stát přes 360 korun
data.description: V Mnichově v sobotu oficiálně začíná 191. ročník slavného Oktoberfestu, který potrvá až do 4. října. Pořadatelé očekávají, že během následujících více než dvou týdnů do bavorské metropole dorazí přes šest milionů návštěvníků z celého světa. Jak se Bavorsko na tradiční událost připravuje, zachytili fotografové.
data.translatedTitle: Oktoberfest is starting in Munich, a liter of beer will cost over 360 crowns
data.translatedDescription: The 191st edition of the famous Oktoberfest, which will last until October 4, officially begins in Munich on Saturday. Organizers expect over six million visitors from all over the world to arrive in the Bavarian capital over the next two weeks. Photographers captured how Bavaria prepares for the traditional event.

data.title: Penál, pastelky, ale i kroužky a obědy. Samoživitelé každé září zápasí s výdaji
data.description: „Na začátku školního roku si musím pokaždé půjčit od rodičů. Nevím, co bych bez nich dělala,“ popisuje samoživitelka Markéta. Zářijové výdaje pro ni nejsou jen nepříjemností, kterou by pokryla z úspor. Podobně jako řada dalších rodičů vychovávajících děti bez partnera totiž nemá žádnou větší finanční rezervu.
data.translatedTitle: Pencil case, crayons, but also circles and lunches. Singles struggle with expenses every September
data.translatedDescription: "At the beginning of the school year, I always have to borrow money from my parents. I don't know what I would do without them," describes single mother Markéta. For her, the September expenses are not just an inconvenience that she would cover from her savings. Like many other parents raising children without a partner, he has no major financial reserves.

data.title: Koksovna v centru Ostravy zůstává problémem. Kandidáti se liší v přístupu k řešení
data.description: Konec těžby uhlí v ostravském regionu Koksovnu Svoboda nezastavil. Naopak. Zatímco ostravští politici znovu mluví o nutnosti řešit její dopady na životní prostředí, podnik plánuje v Přívoze dál vyrábět statisíce tun koksu ročně.
data.translatedTitle: The coking plant in the center of Ostrava remains a problem. Candidates differ in their approach to the solution
data.translatedDescription: The end of coal mining in the Ostrava region did not stop Coke Svoboda. On the contrary. While Ostrava's politicians are once again talking about the need to address its effects on the environment, the company plans to continue producing hundreds of thousands of tons of coke per year in Přívoz.

data.title: Daniela Kolářová slaví osmdesátiny u Cibulky. Osobně jí popřejí Kostka či Stivín
data.description: Daniela Kolářová slaví ve Vršovickém divadle Mana své blížící se 80. narozeniny. Průvodcem sobotního dvouhodinového programu, který začíná v 11:00, bude moderátor Aleš Cibulka. Kromě oslavenkyně zde vystoupí Petr Kostka, Carmen Mayerová, Jiří Stivín a další. Český rozhlas oslavu pojal jako speciální živé vydání svého pořadu Tobogan.
data.translatedTitle: Daniela Kolářová celebrates her 80th birthday at Cibulka's. Kostka or Stivín will personally deny her
data.translatedDescription: Daniela Kolářová is celebrating her approaching 80th birthday at the Mana Theater in Vršovice. The guide for Saturday's two-hour program, which starts at 11:00, will be the moderator Aleš Cibulka. In addition to the birthday girl, Petr Kostka, Carmen Mayerová, Jiří Stivín and others will perform here. Czech Radio conceived the celebration as a special live edition of its program Tobogan.

data.title: Trump podepsal „pekelné sankce“ proti Rusku. Jsou odkazem zesnulého senátora
data.description: Americký prezident Donald Trump v pátek podepsal zákon zavádějící rozsáhlé sankce, které mají dostat Rusko pod větší tlak a napomoci ukončení války na Ukrajině. Sankční balík je odkazem republikánského senátora Lindseye Grahama, který zemřel v červenci krátce po své poslední návštěvě Ukrajiny. Ukrajina se pátým rokem s pomocí Západu brání ruské agresi.
data.translatedTitle: Trump signs 'hellish sanctions' against Russia. They are a legacy of the late senator
data.translatedDescription: US President Donald Trump on Friday signed into law a law imposing sweeping sanctions to put more pressure on Russia and help end the war in Ukraine. The sanctions package is a legacy of Republican Senator Lindsey Graham, who died in July shortly after his last visit to Ukraine. Ukraine is defending itself against Russian aggression for the fifth year with the help of the West.

data.title: Dny NATO 2026 startují. Návštěvníci čekají v kolonách až dvě hodiny
data.description: Na mošnovském letišti začínají dvoudenní Dny NATO v Ostravě a Dny Vzdušných sil Armády ČR, které jsou největší bezpečnostní přehlídkou v Evropě. Po oba dny čeká návštěvníky přes osm hodin atraktivních ukázek na zemi i nebi. Brány areálu se návštěvníkům otevřely v 8:15.
data.translatedTitle: NATO Days 2026 start. Visitors wait in queues for up to two hours
data.translatedDescription: The two-day NATO Days in Ostrava and Czech Air Force Days, which are the largest security parade in Europe, begin at the Mošnov airport. On both days, visitors can expect more than eight hours of attractive demonstrations on earth and in the sky. The gates of the complex opened to visitors at 8:15.

data.title: Německo mění pravidla placení. Podniky budou muset přijímat i digitální platby
data.description: Německé restaurace a obchody, které dnes přijímají pouze hotovost, budou muset od příštího roku nabídnout i možnost digitální platby. Počítá s tím spolkové ministerstvo financí. Možnost zaplatit hotově ale má zůstat zachována i dál.
data.translatedTitle: Germany changes payment rules. Businesses will also have to accept digital payments
data.translatedDescription: German restaurants and shops that only accept cash today will have to offer a digital payment option from next year. The Federal Ministry of Finance is counting on this. However, the option to pay in cash should remain.

data.title: Základem jídelníčku bývalo zelí, rodina ho snědla 400 kilo za rok. Chlebem se šetřilo
data.description: Báleše, manželstvo nebo kvaka. Názvy kdysi oblíbených pokrmů dnes už lidem mnoho neříkají. Některé z nich můžete ochutnat například na Slováckém festivalu chutí a vůní ve skanzenu Rochus v Uherském Hradišti.
data.translatedTitle: Cabbage used to be the basis of the menu, the family ate 400 kilos of it per year. Bread was spared
data.translatedDescription: Baleše, marriage or quack. The names of once popular dishes no longer mean much to people. You can taste some of them, for example, at the Slovakian Festival of Flavors and Fragrances in the Rochus open-air museum in Uherské Hradiště.

data.title: Rusko útočí na spojence Ukrajiny už pět let, prohlásil Trump
data.description: Rusko už roky útočí na spojence Ukrajiny. V rozhovoru s novináři to v pátek prohlásil americký prezident Donald Trump, který tak reagoval na varování polských představitelů před ruskými hybridními útoky na země stojící za Kyjevem.
data.translatedTitle: Russia has been attacking Ukraine's allies for five years, Trump said
data.translatedDescription: Russia has been attacking Ukraine's allies for years. US President Donald Trump said this in an interview with journalists on Friday, who responded to the warning of Polish officials about Russian hybrid attacks on countries behind Kiev.

data.title: Při komunistickém útlaku dostal nápad. Inženýr vymyslel zapomenuté dvojče Lega
data.description: Šikovné prsty spojují jednu kostičku stavebnice s druhou. Výstupky zapadají do otvorů a před očima postupně roste malý dům. Ještě pár a hotovo – stavba bude určitě stejně pěkná jako ta na krabici. Nenechte se však zmást, nemluví se tady o známém Legu. Nebo alespoň ne úplně. Tentokrát je řeč o takzvaném „Litoměřickém Legu“ neboli stavebnici Tegula, kterou ve druhé polovině minulého století používaly tisíce školáku v celém Československu.
data.translatedTitle: He got an idea during communist oppression. An engineer invented the forgotten twin of Lego
data.translatedDescription: Clever fingers connect one building block to another. The protrusions fit into the holes and a small house gradually grows before the eyes. A few more and you're done - the build will definitely be as nice as the one on the box. However, do not be confused, we are not talking about the well-known Lego here. Or at least not completely. This time we are talking about the so-called "Litoměřice Lego", or Tegula kit, which was used by thousands of schoolchildren throughout Czechoslovakia in the second half of the last century.

data.title: Denně zde nastoupí jediný člověk. Vlaková zastávka Pohledští Dvořáci míří ke konci
data.description: Město Havlíčkův Brod zřejmě přijde o jednu ze svých čtyř menších železničních zastávek. Správa železnic navrhuje zrušit zastavování vlaků v Pohledských Dvořácích. Vedení radnice k tomu sice souhlas nedalo, nechalo situaci posoudit Kraj Vysočina, ale zároveň proti chystanému kroku nikterak neprotestuje.
data.translatedTitle: Only one person boards here daily. The Pohledští Dvořáci train stop is coming to an end
data.translatedDescription: The city of Havlíčkův Brod will apparently lose one of its four smaller railway stops. The Railway Administration proposes to cancel the stopping of trains in Pohledské Dvořáce. Although the management of the town hall did not agree to this, they left the situation to the Region of Vysočina to assess, but at the same time they do not protest against the planned step in any way.

data.title: Na Rakovnicku hořela průmyslová hala, škoda jde do stovek milionů
data.description: Hasiči dostali páteční požár v průmyslové hale na zpracování plastů v Rynholci před půlnocí pod kontrolu. Postupně snížili poplachový stupeň na základní. V budově už není materiál, jednotka záchranného útvaru hasičů, která pomáhala s vyskladněním, odjela zpět na základnu, sdělila mluvčí středočeských hasičů Tereza Sýkora Fliegerová.
data.translatedTitle: An industrial hall burned down in Rakovnick, the damage runs into hundreds of millions
data.translatedDescription: Firefighters brought Friday's fire in an industrial hall for plastics processing in Rynholec under control before midnight. They gradually reduced the alarm level to basic. There is no more material in the building, the unit of the rescue unit of the fire department, which helped with the removal, went back to the base, said the spokesperson of the central Bohemian fire department, Tereza Sýkora Fliegerová.

data.title: Václav Havel očima mladé generace. Studenti Sutnarky zpracovali jeho odkaz
data.description: Jak vidí Václava Havla generace, která nezažila komunistický režim ani jeho prezidentskou éru? Studenti Fakulty designu a umění Ladislava Sutnara Západočeské univerzity v Plzni si jeho texty a myšlenky vzali jako materiál pro vlastní tvorbu. Výsledkem jsou desítky různých interpretací – od malby a fotografie přes ilustraci až po nová média. Projekt Havel 26 připomene Havlovy nedožité 90. narozeniny.
data.translatedTitle: Václav Havel through the eyes of the young generation. Sutnarka students processed his legacy
data.translatedDescription: How does the generation that did not experience the communist regime or its presidential era see Václav Havel? Students of the Ladislav Sutnar Faculty of Design and Art of the University of West Bohemia in Pilsen took his texts and ideas as material for their own creations. The result is dozens of different interpretations – from painting and photography to illustration and new media. The Havel 26 project will commemorate Havel's missed 90th birthday.

data.title: Sebevražedný útok v Pákistánu zabil nejméně 31 lidí, desítky utrpěly zranění
data.description: Na nejméně 31 vzrostl počet lidí, které zabil páteční sebevražedný útok s použitím silné bomby u mešity v policejním areálu na severozápadě Pákistánu. Zranění utrpěla stovka lidí.
data.translatedTitle: A suicide attack in Pakistan has killed at least 31 people and injured dozens
data.translatedDescription: At least 31 people have been killed in Friday's suicide attack outside a mosque in a police compound in northwestern Pakistan. A hundred people were injured.

data.title: TELEVIZIONÁŘ: Jeden ze dvou Nepelů je tady. Hraje ho Slovák, režíroval Čech
data.description: Titul s názvem Šampión, jehož televizní premiéru uvádí v sobotu stanice HBO, je jedním ze dvou projektů, které se věnovaly stejné životní etapě téže reálné osobnosti, krasobruslaři Ondreji Nepelovi.
data.translatedTitle: TV Host: One of the two Nepels is here. He is played by a Slovak, directed by a Czech
data.translatedDescription: The title, Champion, whose television premiere is presented on Saturday by HBO, is one of two projects that focused on the same life stage of the same real-life personality, figure skater Ondrej Nepel.

data.title: USA uzavřely dohodu o Grónsku, oznámil Trump. Získají kontrolu nad bezpečností
data.description: Americký prezident Donald Trump v pátek oznámil, že se dohodl s Dánskem na urovnání vztahů kolem Grónska. USA tam nyní budou kontrolovat své bezpečnostní zájmy a žádná nepřátelská země si tam nebude moci vybudovat základnu bez amerického souhlasu, uvedl. Úřad dánské premiérky informoval, že dohoda bude podepsána příští týden.
data.translatedTitle: The US has made a deal on Greenland, Trump announced. They gain control over security
data.translatedDescription: US President Donald Trump announced on Friday that he had agreed with Denmark to settle relations over Greenland. The US will now control its security interests there and no hostile country will be able to build a base there without US approval, he said. The office of the Danish Prime Minister informed that the agreement will be signed next week.

data.title: Kdo kandiduje v Praze? Přehled kandidátů a lídrů pro komunální i senátní volby 2026
data.description: Komunální volby 2026 v Praze se konají 9. a 10. října a Pražané v nich rozhodnou o obsazení 65 křesel v Zastupitelstvu hlavního města Prahy. O jejich hlasy se uchází 24 zaregistrovaných volebních subjektů. Současný primátor Bohuslav Svoboda (ODS) svůj mandát neobhajuje a koalici SPOLU vede do voleb starosta Prahy 9 Tomáš Portlík. Přehled průběžně aktualizujeme.
data.translatedTitle: Who is running in Prague? Overview of candidates and leaders for the 2026 municipal and senate elections
data.translatedDescription: Municipal elections 2026 in Prague will be held on October 9 and 10, and the people of Prague will decide on the occupation of 65 seats in the Prague City Council. 24 registered electoral entities are vying for their votes. The current mayor Bohuslav Svoboda (ODS) is not defending his mandate, and the TOGETHER coalition is being led into the elections by the mayor of Prague 9, Tomáš Portlík. We continuously update the overview.

data.title: Jak naplánovat firemní večírek, na který budou všichni rádi vzpomínat?
data.description: Pravidelný firemní večírek je pro většinu společností hlavním momentem roku. Je to příležitost poděkovat týmu za odvedenou práci, oslavit společné úspěchy a upevnit vztahy v neformálním prostředí. Jenže zorganizovat akci, která nekončí rozpačitým přešlapováním u chlebíčků, vyžaduje promyšlenou přípravu. Od volby správného místa přes poctivou gastronomii až po večerní zábavu – u úspěšného večírku rozhodují detaily, logistika i schopnost vytvořit neopakovatelnou atmosféru.
data.translatedTitle: How to plan a company party that everyone will remember fondly?
data.translatedDescription: A regular company party is the highlight of the year for most companies. It is an opportunity to thank the team for the work done, celebrate joint achievements and strengthen relationships in an informal setting. But organizing an event that doesn't end with an embarrassing misstep at the sandwiches requires thoughtful preparation. From choosing the right place to honest gastronomy to evening entertainment – ​​details, logistics and the ability to create a unique atmosphere are decisive for a successful party.

data.title: Požár haly na zpracování plastů v Rynholci hasiči dostali pod kontrolu
data.description: Hasiči dostali požár v průmyslové hale na zpracování plastů v Rynholci před půlnocí pod kontrolu a nad ránem snížili poplach na základní, přičemž škoda se podle předběžných odhadů pohybuje mezi 300 a 400 miliony korun.
data.translatedTitle: Firefighters brought the fire at the plastics processing hall in Rynholec under control
data.translatedDescription: Firefighters brought the fire in an industrial hall for processing plastics in Rynholec under control before midnight and reduced the alarm to basic in the morning, with damage estimated at between 300 and 400 million crowns.

data.title: Taxikáře čeká test z češtiny a místopisu. Kritici varují před zdražením
data.description: Místo pozdravu jen tiché kývnutí a oči upřené do mobilu. Pro mnohé cestující v Praze běžná realita při jízdě s řidiči alternativních taxislužeb, jako je Uber nebo Bolt. Jen v Praze jezdí 15 tisíc taxikářů, 45 procent z nich jsou cizinci, nejvíce Ukrajinci. Ti mají problém se s cestujícími dorozumět, často v ulicích tápou a spoléhají se jen na navigační aplikace.
data.translatedTitle: The taxi driver faces a test in Czech and geography. Critics warn of price hikes
data.translatedDescription: Instead of a greeting, only a silent nod and eyes fixed on the mobile phone. For many travelers in Prague, a common reality when driving with drivers of alternative taxi services such as Uber or Bolt. There are 15,000 taxi drivers in Prague alone, 45 percent of them are foreigners, mostly Ukrainians. They have trouble communicating with passengers, often get lost in the streets and rely only on navigation applications.

data.title: Sazby hypoték míří k šesti procentům. Splátky vyskočí o tisíce korun
data.description: Začátek září přinesl další zdražení hypoték, když úroky vystoupaly na nejvyšší hodnoty za poslední dva roky. Ještě na jaře se přitom čekalo zlevňování. Pak ale válka zablokovala Hormuzský průliv a kvůli pokračující geopolitické nestabilitě, rostoucím cenám ropy a nervozitě trhů z rostoucího zadlužování států i firem se bankám zdražují náklady na dlouhodobé financování.
data.translatedTitle: Mortgage rates are heading for six percent. Installments will jump by thousands of crowns
data.translatedDescription: The beginning of September brought another rise in mortgage prices, with interest rates rising to their highest levels in two years. At the same time, price reductions were still expected in the spring. But then the war blocked the Strait of Hormuz, and due to the ongoing geopolitical instability, rising oil prices and market nervousness from the increasing indebtedness of states and companies, the costs of long-term financing are becoming more expensive for banks.

data.title: Zákaz vývozu hovězího rozhořčil Brazilce. EU jim ničí image
data.description: Sotva před několika měsíci oschnul inkoust na obchodní dohodě mezi EU a uskupeními zemí Jižní Ameriky, tzv. Mercosurem, přišlo pro tamní farmáře vystřízlivění. EU už v květnu vyřadila Brazílii ze seznamu zemí, které dodržují unijní pravidla proti zneužívání antibiotik v chovu hospodářských zvířat, v září pak zakázala dovoz živočišných komodit, což se u Česka týká hlavně drůbežího a hovězího masa.
data.translatedTitle: Beef export ban angers Brazilians. The EU is destroying their image
data.translatedDescription: As soon as the ink dried on the trade agreement between the EU and the grouping of South American countries, the so-called Mercosur, a few months ago, there was a sobering up for the farmers there. In May, the EU removed Brazil from the list of countries that comply with EU rules against the abuse of antibiotics in livestock farming, and in September it banned the import of animal commodities, which in the Czech Republic mainly concerns poultry and beef.

data.title: Učil němčinu, hrál divadlo. Dnes řídí obchod ve firmě zvané puren
data.description: Od katedry přes divadelní prkna až do světa stavebnictví. Miroslav Vala, obchodní ředitel puren, prošel profesní cestou, která rozhodně nebyla nalinkovaná. V rozhovoru pro iDNES.cz mluví o odvaze změnit obor, práci s lidmi i o tom, proč se zkušenosti z učitelství a divadla v byznysu neztrácejí – a někdy se hodí víc, než by člověk čekal.
data.translatedTitle: He taught German, played theater. Today he manages the store in a company called puren
data.translatedDescription: From the department through theater boards to the world of construction. Miroslav Vala, commercial director of puren, has followed a professional path that was definitely not lined. In an interview for iDNES.cz, he talks about the courage to change fields, work with people and why experience from teaching and theater is not lost in business - and sometimes it comes in handy more than one would expect.

data.title: Lžou, nesmí do Bílého domu! Trump se zbavil novinářů ze CNN, MSNOW a Politico

data.translatedTitle: Venezuela. Government and opposition create commission to discuss freedom of expression
data.translatedDescription: The Venezuelan government and opposition announced this Friday the creation of a commission to analyze issues related to freedom of expression and the right to information.

data.title: Líderes da OpenAI e Nvidia presentes em jantar com Xi Jinping na Casa Branca
data.description: Os responsáveis da tecnológicas OpenAI e da Nvidia vão participar na quinta-feira de um jantar oferecido em honra de Xi Jinping na Casa Branca, indicou um responsável norte-americano.
data.translatedTitle: OpenAI and Nvidia leaders present at dinner with Xi Jinping at the White House
data.translatedDescription: Those responsible for OpenAI and Nvidia technology will participate in a dinner held in honor of Xi Jinping at the White House on Thursday, a US official said.

data.title: CNN e Politico contestam legalidade de exclusão da Casa Branca anunciada por Trump
data.description: Os media norte-americanos CNN e Politico contestaram hoje a legalidade da sua exclusão da Casa Branca, anunciada pelo Presidente Donald Trump.
data.translatedTitle: CNN and Politico dispute the legality of Trump's exclusion from the White House
data.translatedDescription: The North American media CNN and Politico today challenged the legality of his exclusion from the White House, announced by President Donald Trump.

data.title: EUA admitem ter perdido confiança nos resultados atuais das missões de paz da ONU
data.description: Os Estados Unidos admitiram na sexta-feira que perderam a confiança de que as missões de paz da ONU, da forma como são atualmente concebidas e financiadas, produzam resultados proporcionais aos seus custos e à sua abrangência.
data.translatedTitle: US admits to having lost confidence in the current results of UN peacekeeping missions
data.translatedDescription: The United States admitted on Friday that it has lost confidence that UN peacekeeping missions, as they are currently designed and financed, produce results commensurate with their costs and scope.

data.title: Gastos dos EUA na guerra contra Irão superam 43,6 mil milhões de dólares até setembro
data.description: Os Estados Unidos gastaram na guerra contra o Irão mais de 43,6 mil milhões de dólares (38 mil milhões de euros) até 03 de setembro, segundo uma nova estimativa apresentada esta semana ao Congresso.
data.translatedTitle: US spending on the war against Iran exceeds $43.6 billion by September
data.translatedDescription: The United States spent more than 43.6 billion dollars (38 billion euros) on the war against Iran as of September 3, according to a new estimate presented this week to Congress.

data.title: Washington Post contraria dados oficiais do Pentágono sobre soldados mortos na guerra com Irão
data.description: O número de soldados norte-americanos mortos na guerra contra o Irão é superior ao divulgado publicamente pelo Pentágono, noticiou o jornal The Washington Post.
data.translatedTitle: Washington Post contradicts official Pentagon data on soldiers killed in the war with Iran
data.translatedDescription: The number of US soldiers killed in the war against Iran is higher than that publicly released by the Pentagon, reported The Washington Post.

data.title: Presidente da FNLA altera data do congresso sob contestação interna em Angola
data.description: A direção da Frente Nacional de Libertação de Angola (FNLA) alterou, na sexta-feira, para novembro a data do congresso para a sucessão previsto para setembro, sob contestação interna.
data.translatedTitle: President of the FNLA changes the date of the congress under internal protest in Angola
data.translatedDescription: The leadership of the National Front for the Liberation of Angola (FNLA) changed, on Friday, the date of the succession congress scheduled for September to November, under internal protest.

data.translatedTitle: Denmark confirms signing of agreement with US on Greenland at UN
data.translatedDescription: Denmark and Greenland confirmed this evening an agreement with the United States on security in the Arctic and the North Atlantic, which should be signed next week, on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.

data.title: Obra sobre prostituição encapotada envolvendo "sugar daddies" vence Arouca Film Festival
data.description: A curta-metragem espanhola "Sugar", sobre prostituição feminina encapotada envolvendo a sedução dos chamados `sugar daddies` através da internet, venceu hoje a 24.ª edição do Arouca Film Festival.
data.translatedTitle: Obra sobre prostituição encapotada envolvendo "sugar daddies" vence Arouca Film Festival
data.translatedDescription: The Spanish short film "Sugar", about hidden female prostitution involving the seduction of so-called 'sugar daddies' via the internet, today won the 24th edition of the Arouca Film Festival.

data.title: Fogo em Aveiro dado como dominado
data.description: O incêndio que deflagrou hoje à tarde num povoamento florestal em Aveiro e que obrigou ao corte total da Autoestrada do Norte (A1), foi dado como dominado cerca das 22:30, informou fonte da Proteção Civil.
data.translatedTitle: Fogo em Aveiro dado como dominado
data.translatedDescription: The fire that broke out this afternoon in a forest settlement in Aveiro and which forced the Northern Motorway (A1) to be completely closed, was considered to be under control at around 10:30 pm, a Civil Protection source said.

data.title: Portugal envia segunda doação de três toneladas de medicamentos
data.description: Portugal enviou cerca de três toneladas de medicamentos para a Venezuela, para apoiar o sistema de saúde do país que "continua sob pressão", na sequência do duplo sismo de junho, anunciou hoje o Ministério da Saúde.
data.translatedTitle: Portugal envia segunda doação de três toneladas de medicamentos
data.translatedDescription: Portugal sent around three tons of medicines to Venezuela, to support the country's health system, which "remains under pressure" following the double earthquake in June, the Ministry of Health announced today.

data.title: Lucro da Infraestruturas de Portugal cai 44% para 43,8 ME no primeiro semestre
data.description: A Infraestruturas de Portugal (IP) registou um lucro consolidado de 43,8 milhões de euros no primeiro semestre, menos 44% em termos homólogos, penalizado pelo aumento dos gastos operacionais, em parte devido às intempéries, e pela redução de alguns rendimentos.
data.translatedTitle: Lucro da Infraestruturas de Portugal cai 44% para 43,8 ME no primeiro semestre
data.translatedDescription: Infraestruturas de Portugal (IP) recorded a consolidated profit of 43.8 million euros in the first half of the year, 44% less year-on-year, penalized by the increase in operating expenses, partly due to bad weather, and the reduction in some income.

data.title: Guterres lamenta recusa dos EUA em atribuir vistos à Autoridade Palestiniana
data.description: O secretário-geral da ONU, António Guterres, lamentou hoje a decisão dos Estados Unidos de negarem vistos aos membros da Organização para a Libertação da Palestina e da Autoridade Palestiniana para se deslocarem às Nações Unidas.
data.translatedTitle: Guterres lamenta recusa dos EUA em atribuir vistos à Autoridade Palestiniana
data.translatedDescription: UN Secretary-General António Guterres today regretted the United States' decision to deny visas to members of the Palestine Liberation Organization and the Palestinian Authority to travel to the United Nations.

data.title: Governo avança com projeto-piloto em municípios para usar IA nos licenciamentos
data.description: O Governo vai avançar já este ano com a implementação de projetos-piloto em alguns municípios para testar o uso de inteligência artificial (IA) nos processos de licenciamento urbanístico, aproveitando a entrada do novo regime jurídico.
data.translatedTitle: Governo avança com projeto-piloto em municípios para usar IA nos licenciamentos
data.translatedDescription: The Government will move forward this year with the implementation of pilot projects in some municipalities to test the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in urban licensing processes, taking advantage of the entry of the new legal regime.

data.title: Economia de Espanha cresceu 2,6% em 2025
data.description: A economia espanhola cresceu 2,6% em 2025, menos duas décimas do que inicialmente estimado, disse hoje o Instituto Nacional de Estatística de Espanha (INE).
data.translatedTitle: Economia de Espanha cresceu 2,6% em 2025
data.translatedDescription: The Spanish economy grew 2.6% in 2025, two tenths less than initially estimated, the Spanish National Statistics Institute (INE) said today.

data.title: MAI espera ter mais polícias em Lisboa até ao fim do ano e deixa Moedas "satisfeito"
data.description: O ministro da Administração Interna afirmou hoje que espera ter mais polícias nas ruas de Lisboa até ao final do ano, o que deixou "muito contente" o presidente da Câmara, que tem reivindicado o reforço de meios na capital.
data.translatedTitle: MAI espera ter mais polícias em Lisboa até ao fim do ano e deixa Moedas "satisfeito"
data.translatedDescription: The Minister of Internal Administration said today that he hopes to have more police officers on the streets of Lisbon by the end of the year, which made the president of the Chamber "very happy", who has been calling for increased resources in the capital.

data.title: Rússia alarga sanções a representantes da UE incluindo eurodeputados
data.description: A Rússia alargou a lista de representantes da União Europeia (UE) proibidos de entrar no país, em retaliação pelas sanções aprovadas em julho devido à invasão da Ucrânia, anunciou hoje a diplomacia russa.
data.translatedTitle: Rússia alarga sanções a representantes da UE incluindo eurodeputados
data.translatedDescription: Russia has expanded the list of European Union (EU) representatives banned from entering the country, in retaliation for the sanctions approved in July due to the invasion of Ukraine, Russian diplomacy announced today.

data.title: Kiev pede que não se reconheça votação em territórios ocupados
data.description: A Ucrânia instou hoje a comunidade internacional a não reconhecer os resultados das eleições parlamentares realizadas pelas autoridades russas em territórios ucranianos ocupados, enquanto alerta para políticas de russificação forçada na tentativa de legitimar o domínio destas áreas.
data.translatedTitle: Kiev pede que não se reconheça votação em territórios ocupados
data.translatedDescription: Ukraine today urged the international community not to recognize the results of parliamentary elections held by Russian authorities in occupied Ukrainian territories, while warning against policies of forced Russification in an attempt to legitimize rule over these areas.

data.title: Venâncio Mondlane confirma presença em julgamento e espera processo sem interferências
data.description: O político moçambicano Venâncio Mondlane confirmou hoje à Lusa que estará presente no julgamento reagendado para 17 de novembro em Moçambique, no qual arrisca mais de 20 anos de prisão, manifestando esperança num processo sem interferências políticas.
data.translatedTitle: Venâncio Mondlane confirma presença em julgamento e espera processo sem interferências
data.translatedDescription: Mozambican politician Venâncio Mondlane confirmed to Lusa today that he will be present at the trial rescheduled for November 17 in Mozambique, in which he risks more than 20 years in prison, expressing hope in a process without political interference.

data.title: Trump signs bill authorizing broad new sanctions to squeeze Russia
data.description: WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump signed a bill Friday authorizing new sanctions designed to pressure Russia over its war in Ukraine, shortly after it received congressional approval this week. It also allows Trump the authority to impose tariffs of up to 100 percent on major buyers of Russian oil and gas, potentially covering China and India.

data.title: Mossi Nduwumwe, le prince qui imprime ses marques à Alger
data.description:
Il y a des destins qui ne s'écrivent pas. Ils se cisèlent, crampon après crampon, dans la chair même du ballon. 
 Ce vendredi 18 septembre 2026, à des milliers de kilomètres de Bujumbura, sous la lumière blafarde d'Alger, un fils du Burundi a rappelé au continent son patronyme. Mossi Nduwumwe.
data.translatedTitle: Mossi Nduwumwe, the prince who leaves his mark in Algiers
data.translatedDescription:
There are destinies that cannot be written. They chisel themselves, crampon by crampon, into the very flesh of the ball. 
 This Friday, September 18, 2026, thousands of kilometers from Bujumbura, under the pale light of Algiers, a son of Burundi reminded the continent of his surname. Mossi Nduwumwe.

data.title: Cameroun : Fame Ndongo annonce le paiement massif des primes de recherche ce 18 septembre
data.description: © DR Le ministre d'État, ministre de l’Enseignement supérieur Jacques Fame Ndongo vient de rendre publics des engagements financiers réalisés ce vendredi pour désamorcer la crise dans les universités d’Etat. Dans un communiqué officiel signé ce jour, le ministre d’Etat annonce la mobilisation effective des fonds sur instructions du président Paul Biya, pour solder la modernisation de la recherche et la dette académique. A ce jour, au titre de l’allocation pour la modernisation de la recherche, un montant de 5,47 milliards de FCFA comptant pour le 4è trimestre de l’année 2025 a été intégralement virée depuis le 26 juillet 2026. Le reliquat du premier trimestre de l’année 2026, un montant de 1,76 milliard de FCFA est payé ce vendredi 18 septembre pour un total trimestre de 4, 86 milliards de FCFA. Pour ce qui est du deuxième trimestre de l’année 2026 le virement de 4,91 milliards de FCFA commence aussi ce vendredi 18 septembre. Les personnels qui sont payés par billetage ont rendez-vous mercredi 23 septembre à 12h au Minesup. En dehors de ces mouvements annoncés dans le cadre de la modernisation de la recherche, la grosse dette académique accumulée entre 2000 et 2021 ne connait pas un nouveau changement. Sur une enveloppe totale de 16,95 milliards FCFA, 7,29 milliards ont déjà été payés depuis le 3 octobre 2025, soit 43%. Il reste 9,69 milliards qui seront payés progressivement, d’après le ministre. Il compte sur la maturité des enseignants pour la poursuite sereine des activités dans un climat social apaisé. Comme pour dire que l’argent est là, que cesse la grève. Mais, il revient au Syndicat national des enseignants du supérieur-Synes-, de décider de lever le mot d’ordre de grève si les concertations de ce vendredi ont abouti à un apaisement. Notons que les enseignants revendiquent le paiement intégral de la dette académique. Nous y reviendrons. Cet article Cameroun : Fame Ndongo annonce le paiement massif des primes de recherche ce 18 septembre est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Cameroon: Fame Ndongo announces the massive payment of research bonuses this September 18
data.translatedDescription: © DR The Minister of State, Minister of Higher Education Jacques Fame Ndongo has just made public financial commitments made this Friday to defuse the crisis in state universities. In an official press release signed today, the Minister of State announces the effective mobilization of funds on the instructions of President Paul Biya, to pay for the modernization of research and the academic debt. To date, as part of the allocation for the modernization of research, an amount of 5.47 billion FCFA counting for the 4th quarter of the year 2025 has been fully transferred since July 26, 2026. The remainder of the first quarter of the year 2026, an amount of 1.76 billion FCFA is paid this Friday, September 18 for a total quarter of 4.86 billion FCFA. As for the second quarter of 2026, the transfer of 4.91 billion FCFA also begins this Friday, September 18. Staff who are paid by ticketing will meet on Wednesday September 23 at 12 p.m. at Minesup. Apart from these movements announced as part of the modernization of research, the large academic debt accumulated between 2000 and 2021 has not seen any further change. Out of a total envelope of 16.95 billion FCFA, 7.29 billion have already been paid since October 3, 2025, or 43%. There remains 9.69 billion which will be paid gradually, according to the minister. It counts on the maturity of teachers for the peaceful pursuit of activities in a peaceful social climate. As if to say that the money is there, let the strike stop. But it is up to the National Union of Higher Education Teachers - Synes - to decide to lift the strike call if the consultations this Friday resulted in appeasement. Note that the teachers are demanding full payment of the academic debt. We will come back to this. data.title: Cameroun : le MRC dénonce 14 ans d’immixtion de l’État et annonce son nouveau présidium pour le 17 octobre
data.description: © JDC C'est une tribune au ton offensif que vient de publier Tiriane Noah, la présidente du Mouvement pour la renaissance du Cameroun (MRC), qui contient le ressentiment du parti à l’égard des manœuvres du pouvoir. Intitulée "Quand l'État se fait juge et partie dans la vie des partis politiques", la tribune de Tiriane Balbine Noah, présidente du MRC, revient sur ce que le parti qualifie de harcèlement administratif systématique depuis sa création en 2012. Et et justifie la démission surprise de Maurice Kamto et Mamadou Mota le 8 septembre dernier. Pour Tiriane Noah, le retrait de Kamto et Mota n'est pas un aveu de faiblesse. C'est une "démarche stratégique" pour, selon ses mots, "s'extirper du piège tendu par l'administration territoriale à travers la contestation administrative et judiciaire". Elle rappelle que l'enjeu n'est pas qui dirige le MRC, mais pourquoi diriger le MRC implique depuis 14 ans "de subir une pression administrative permanente". Le MRC annonce que le processus devant aboutir à la désignation de son nouveau présidium se tiendra le 17 octobre prochain, et demande qu'il se déroule "sans immixtion". Le récit d'un harcèlement documenté La tribune dresse une chronologie : entre 2013 et 2017, plusieurs dizaines de manifestations déclarées ont été interdites. En 2018, année électorale, Maurice Kamto et près de 300 militants ont été emprisonnés 9 mois après la présidentielle. En 2020, autre année électorale, des militants ont été arrêtés pour avoir distribué des masques et du gel pendant le Covid-19. Entre 2023 et 2026, un meeting a été interdit à Ebolowa, la cérémonie de nouveaux militants interrompue à Bafoussam, l’assemblée régionale dispersée dans un domicile privé à Bertoua en août 2026 pour "réunion publique non déclarée". Outre ces interdictions et détentions, le parti dénonce une justice à deux vitesses. A titre illustratif, une plainte du MRC en 2023 contre deux communicants du RDPC ayant évoqué un coup d'État en cas de victoire du MRC est restée sans suite. Alors qu'une plainte contre Maurice Kamto en juin 2025 pour des propos à Paris a saisi un tribunal militaire "en quelques jours". Le cœur du contentieux : la lettre du ministre Paul Atanga Nji Le point le plus récent concerne la convention nationale du MRC. Interdite en novembre 2025, elle s'est tenue en visioconférence le 21 décembre 2025 et a acté le retour de Maurice Kamto à la tête du parti. Contre toute attente, le 19 août 2026, soit 8 mois plus tard, le ministre de l'Administration territoriale Paul Atanga Nji a adressé une correspondance refusant de prendre acte des résolutions, en s'appuyant sur l'article 3 alinéa 2 de la loi 90/055 de 1990. Pour le MRC, cette lettre souffre d'un "vice de forclusion". L'article 5 de la même loi prévoit 3 mois pour faire des observations. Le délai serait donc largement dépassé, rendant la correspondance "sans portée en droit". Le parti lie cette lettre à l'action de Joseph Thierry Okala Ebode, ancien cadre exclu le 7 novembre 2025 par le Comité de médiation et d'arbitrage après une plainte du Pr Alain Fogue, qui conteste désormais les résolutions. MANIDEM, CPP, UPC : "une méthode" Tiriane Noah élargit le propos au-delà du MRC, parlant d'une "pratique institutionnelle" visant à fragiliser les partis politiques. Le CPP de Kah Walla aurait vu en 2020 le MINAT tenter de désavouer sa présidente au profit d'un dissident, tentative déjouée par la justice. L’UPC aurait connu une désignation d'un "seul leader" par décision ministérielle en juillet 2018, suspendue 2 ans plus tard par le tribunal administratif pour "immixtion illégale". Le cas le plus cité : le MANIDEM. Dans la nuit du 21 au 22 juillet 2025, le nom d'Anicet Ekane, président légitime, aurait disparu du site du MINAT au profit de Dieudonné Yebga. Quelques jours plus tard, Yebga dépose une candidature MANIDEM à la présidentielle, créant une "pluralité d'investiture" qui servira à ELECAM le 26 juillet et au Conseil constitutionnel le 5 août à écarter la candidature de Maurice Kamto investie par le MANIDEM. La tribune évoque un enregistrement audio imputant à Yebga avoir agi "avec l'aval du ministre". Enfin, la tribune dénonce le calendrier électoral : législatives et municipales prévues en février 2025, reportées une première fois en juillet 2024. Puis à nouveau prorogées jusqu'au 20 décembre 2026, avec suppression de la limite de 18 mois pour les municipaux. "Trois reports en deux ans ! Un régime sûr de sa victoire ne fait pas ça", écrit-elle. Un enjeu d'image Au-delà du MRC, Tiriane Noah estime que c'est "la civilisation des mœurs politiques" et "l'image du Cameroun" qui est en jeu, à quelques semaines de l'Examen périodique universel des droits de l'homme en octobre, et alors que le budget 2027 affiche déjà 200 milliards de recettes en moins. "Un pays qui a besoin de rassurer ses créanciers ne peut pas se permettre de faire douter de l'État de droit. Un parti solide n'est pas un risque, c'est un signal de maturité envoyé aux investisseurs", plaide-t-elle. La tribune conclut : "Nous n'attendons pas de faveur. Nous demandons l'application stricte des textes. Un pouvoir qui laisse son peuple choisir ses dirigeants n'écrit dans l'histoire que la preuve de sa force." La présidente semble maintenir dans cette tribune la ligne de combat de Maurice Kamto et de Mamadou Mota. Cet article Cameroun : le MRC dénonce 14 ans d’immixtion de l’État et annonce son nouveau présidium pour le 17 octobre est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Cameroon: the MRC denounces 14 years of state interference and announces its new presidium for October 17
data.translatedDescription: © JDC It is a column with an offensive tone that Tiriane Noah, the president of the Movement for the Renaissance of Cameroon (MRC), has just published, which contains the party's resentment towards the maneuvers of power. Entitled "When the State becomes judge and party in the life of political parties", the column by Tiriane Balbine Noah, president of the MRC, reviews what the party describes as systematic administrative harassment since its creation in 2012. And and justifies the surprise resignation of Maurice Kamto and Mamadou Mota on September 8. For Tiriane Noah, the withdrawal of Kamto and Mota is not an admission of weakness. It is a “strategic approach” to, in his words, “extricate ourselves from the trap set by the territorial administration through administrative and legal challenge”. She recalls that the issue is not who runs the MRC, but why running the MRC has meant “undergoing permanent administrative pressure” for 14 years. The MRC announces that the process leading to the designation of its new presidium will be held on October 17, and asks that it take place “without interference”. The story of documented harassment The forum draws up a chronology: between 2013 and 2017, several dozen declared demonstrations were banned. In 2018, an election year, Maurice Kamto and nearly 300 activists were imprisoned 9 months after the presidential election. In 2020, another election year, activists were arrested for distributing masks and gel during Covid-19. Between 2023 and 2026, a meeting was banned in Ebolowa, the ceremony of new activists interrupted in Bafoussam, the regional assembly dispersed to a private home in Bertoua in August 2026 for "undeclared public meeting". In addition to these bans and detentions, the party denounces two-tier justice. For example, a complaint from the MRC in 2023 against two RDPC communicators who mentioned a coup d'état in the event of a victory for the MRC remained unanswered. While a complaint against Maurice Kamto in June 2025 for comments in Paris went to a military court “within a few days”. The heart of the dispute: the letter from Minister Paul Atanga Nji The most recent point concerns the MRC national convention. Banned in November 2025, it was held by videoconference on December 21, 2025 and recorded the return of Maurice Kamto at the head of the party. Against all expectations, on August 19, 2026, i.e. 8 months later, the Minister of Territorial Administration Paul Atanga Nji sent a correspondence refusing to take note of the resolutions, relying on article 3 paragraph 2 of law 90/055 of 1990. For the MRC, this letter suffers from a "defect of foreclosure". Article 5 of the same law provides for 3 months to make observations. The deadline would therefore be largely exceeded, making the correspondence "without legal significance". The party links this letter to the action of Joseph Thierry Okala Ebode, a former executive excluded on November 7, 2025 by the Mediation and Arbitration Committee after a complaint from Professor Alain Fogue, who now contests the resolutions. MANIDEM, CPP, UPC: “a method” Tiriane Noah broadens the subject beyond the MRC, speaking of an “institutional practice” aimed at weakening political parties. The CPP of Kah Walla would have seen in 2020 the MINAT attempt to disavow its president in favor of a dissident, an attempt foiled by the courts. The UPC would have seen the designation of a “single leader” by ministerial decision in July 2018, suspended 2 years later by the administrative court for “illegal interference”. The most cited case: MANIDEM. On the night of July 21 to 22, 2025, the name of Anicet Ekane, legitimate president, disappeared from the MINAT website in favor of Dieudonné Yebga. A few days later, Yebga submitted a MANIDEM candidacy for the presidential election, creating a "plurality of nomination" which would be used by ELECAM on July 26 and by the Constitutional Council on August 5 to rule out the candidacy of Maurice Kamto nominated by MANIDEM. The column mentions an audio recording attributing to Yebga having acted “with the approval of the minister”. Finally, the forum denounces the electoral calendar: legislative and municipal elections scheduled for February 2025, postponed for the first time to July 2024. Then extended again until December 20, 2026, with removal of the 18-month limit for municipal elections. “Three postponements in two years! A regime sure of its victory does not do that,” she wrote. An image issue Beyond the MRC, Tiriane Noah believes that it is "the civilization of political morals" and "the image of Cameroon" which is at stake, a few weeks before the Universal Periodic Review of Human Rights in October, and while the 2027 budget already shows 200 billion less revenue. “A country that needs to reassure its creditors cannot afford to cast doubt on the rule of law. A solid party is not a risk, it is a signal of maturity sent to investors,” she argues. The forum concludes: "We do not expect favors. We ask for the strict application of the texts. A power which lets its people choose its leaders only writes in history the proof of its strength." The president seems to maintain the battle line of Maurice Kamto and Mamadou Mota in this forum. This article Cameroon: the MRC denounces 14 years of state interference and announces its new presidium for October 17 appeared first on Journalducameroun.com.

data.title: Coopération interministérielle : MINADER, MINEPIA et MINEFOP unissent leurs forces pour la formation agropastorale
data.description: © DR Mercredi 17 septembre 2026 à Yaoundé, trois départements ministériels ont franchi une étape majeure en signant un cadre de collaboration tripartite pour le capital humain agropastoral et halieutique. Une convention avec la GIZ allemande vient renforcer cette dynamique. C'est un nouveau cap pour le capital humain au Cameroun. Le Ministère de l'Agriculture et du Développement Rural (MINADER), le Ministère de l'Élevage, des Pêches et des Industries Animales (MINEPIA) et le Ministère de l'Emploi et de la Formation Professionnelle (MINEFOP) ont officialisé leur partenariat, le mercredi 17 septembre 2026 à Yaoundé. La cérémonie a connu son point d'orgue avec la signature solennelle du cadre de collaboration tripartite, sous les applaudissements. Dans la foulée, une Convention de coopération (MoU) a été signée entre le MINEFOP et l'Agence de coopération allemande GIZ. Prenant la parole, les trois membres du Gouvernement ont insisté sur la portée stratégique de l'accord. Pour le Dr Taïga, Ministre du MINEPIA, il faut « arrimer la formation aux réalités des bassins de production ». Le Ministre du MINEFOP par intérim, Mounouna Foutsou, a présenté ce cadre comme « une réponse concrète à l'inadéquation formation-emploi dans les secteurs porteurs». Enfin, le MINADER, Gabriel Mbaïrobé, a souligné que cette mutualisation permettra de « bâtir un écosystème de formation plus cohérent, plus professionnalisant et orienté vers l'entrepreneuriat rural». L'objectif est d'harmoniser les politiques de formation, de développer des référentiels de métiers communs et de renforcer l'employabilité des jeunes dans les chaînes de valeur agropastorales. Clôturée par une photo de famille, la cérémonie confirme la volonté du Gouvernement de faire de la formation professionnelle le socle de la transformation structurelle de l'économie camerounaise. Cet article Coopération interministérielle : MINADER, MINEPIA et MINEFOP unissent leurs forces pour la formation agropastorale est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Interministerial cooperation: MINADER, MINEPIA and MINEFOP join forces for agropastoral training
data.translatedDescription: © DR Wednesday September 17, 2026 in Yaoundé, three ministerial departments took a major step forward by signing a tripartite collaboration framework for agropastoral and fisheries human capital. An agreement with the German GIZ reinforces this dynamic. This is a new milestone for human capital in Cameroon. The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MINADER), the Ministry of Livestock, Fisheries and Animal Industries (MINEPIA) and the Ministry of Employment and Vocational Training (MINEFOP) formalized their partnership on Wednesday September 17, 2026 in Yaoundé. The ceremony culminated with the solemn signing of the tripartite collaboration framework, to applause. Subsequently, a Cooperation Agreement (MoU) was signed between MINEFOP and the German Cooperation Agency GIZ. Speaking, the three members of the Government insisted on the strategic scope of the agreement. For Dr Taïga, Minister of MINEPIA, we must “link training to the realities of production areas”. The interim Minister of MINEFOP, Mounouna Foutsou, presented this framework as “a concrete response to the training-employment mismatch in promising sectors”. Finally, MINADER, Gabriel Mbaïrobé, underlined that this pooling will make it possible to “build a more coherent, more professional training ecosystem and oriented towards rural entrepreneurship”. The objective is to harmonize training policies, develop common job standards and strengthen the employability of young people in agropastoral value chains. Closed with a family photo, the ceremony confirms the Government's desire to make vocational training the basis of the structural transformation of the Cameroonian economy. data.title: Pharmacopée traditionnelle : le MINRESI fait du Made in Cameroon un levier de souveraineté sanitaire
data.description: © DR Représentant la ministre Madeleine Tchuinté, le Pr Rebecca Ebele Etame a conduit la délégation du MINRESI au colloque national sur la valorisation de la pharmacopée traditionnelle camerounaise, ouvert le 17 septembre 2026 à Yaoundé I. La pharmacopée traditionnelle au cœur de la politique du Made in Cameroon. Le MINRESI a marqué de son empreinte le Colloque national sur la valorisation de la pharmacopée traditionnelle, ouvert le jeudi 17 septembre 2026 à l'Amphithéâtre 700 de la Faculté de Médecine et des Sciences Biomédicales de l'Université de Yaoundé I. En sa qualité de représentante de la Ministre de la Recherche Scientifique et de l'Innovation, Dr Madeleine Tchuinté, le Secrétaire Général du MINRESI, Pr Rebecca Ebele Etame, a conduit la délégation ministérielle. La cérémonie était présidée par le Ministre d'Etat, Ministre de l'Enseignement Supérieur, Pr Jacques Fame Ndongo, en présence de la Ministre de la Promotion de la Femme et de la Famille, Pr Marie-Thérèse Abena Ondoa, chercheurs, universitaires et tradipraticiens. Dans son allocution, le Pr Ebele Etame a salué une initiative qui offre « un cadre privilégié de réflexion, d'échange et de partage d'expériences sur ce domaine important de la vie nationale ». Pour elle, « la pharmacopée traditionnelle apparaît comme une opportunité pour renforcer le Made in Cameroon et favoriser l'émergence d'une véritable industrie nationale des produits de santé et de bien-être ». Elle a rappelé la doctrine du MINRESI : « transformer les savoirs endogènes sur les plantes médicinales en connaissances scientifiques, en innovations, en solutions de santé et en opportunités économiques, dans le respect des droits des communautés et de la conservation de la biodiversité ». Une mission portée par l'Institut de Recherches Médicales et d'Études des Plantes Médicinales (IMPM). Après la leçon inaugurale du Pr Mpondo Mpondo Emmanuel, les ateliers coordonnés par le Pr Emmanuel Nga Nnanga ont démarré. Le MINRESI est intervenu dans le sous-thème 2 sur l'industrialisation, avec un exposé du Pr Joséphine Ngo Mbing intitulé « De la valorisation des savoirs endogènes à la recherche et l'innovation ». Cet article Pharmacopée traditionnelle : le MINRESI fait du Made in Cameroon un levier de souveraineté sanitaire est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Traditional pharmacopoeia: MINRESI makes Made in Cameroon a lever for health sovereignty
data.translatedDescription: © DR Representing Minister Madeleine Tchuinté, Professor Rebecca Ebele Etame led the MINRESI delegation to the national conference on the promotion of traditional Cameroonian pharmacopoeia, opening on September 17, 2026 in Yaoundé I. Traditional pharmacopoeia at the heart of the Made in Cameroon policy. MINRESI left its mark on the national conference on the promotion of traditional pharmacopoeia, opened on Thursday September 17, 2026 at the Amphitheater 700 of the Faculty of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences of the University of Yaoundé I. In her capacity as representative of the Minister of Scientific Research and Innovation, Dr Madeleine Tchuinté, the Secretary General of MINRESI, Professor Rebecca Ebele Etame, led the ministerial delegation. The ceremony was chaired by the Minister of State, Minister of Higher Education, Professor Jacques Fame Ndongo, in the presence of the Minister for the Promotion of Women and the Family, Professor Marie-Thérèse Abena Ondoa, researchers, academics and traditional practitioners. In his speech, Professor Ebele Etame welcomed an initiative which offers “a privileged framework for reflection, exchange and sharing of experiences on this important area of ​​national life”. For her, “the traditional pharmacopoeia appears as an opportunity to strengthen Made in Cameroon and promote the emergence of a true national industry of health and well-being products”. She recalled the MINRESI doctrine: “transform endogenous knowledge on medicinal plants into scientific knowledge, innovations, health solutions and economic opportunities, while respecting the rights of communities and the conservation of biodiversity”. A mission carried out by the Institute of Medical Research and Studies of Medicinal Plants (IMPM). After the inaugural lesson by Professor Mpondo Mpondo Emmanuel, the workshops coordinated by Professor Emmanuel Nga Nnanga began. MINRESI intervened in sub-theme 2 on industrialization, with a presentation by Professor Joséphine Ngo Mbing entitled “From the valorization of endogenous knowledge to research and innovation”. data.title: Journée Internationale de la Paix : le Cameroun mise sur le dialogue pour investir dans la paix au quotidien
data.description: © DR Placée sous le thème « Investir dans la paix pour tous, partout, chaque jour », la 45e édition de la Journée Internationale de la Paix a été lancée le 16 septembre 2026 par un Hangout national réunissant administrations, forces de défense, société civile et diaspora pour réfléchir à la consolidation de la paix au Cameroun. Comment consolider la paix tous les jours, sur tous les fronts ? C'est la question centrale du Hangout organisé le 16 septembre 2026 pour le lancement des activités de la Journée Internationale de la Paix. Ouvrant les échanges au nom du Ministre de la Jeunesse et de l'Education Civique, Paschal Kum Awah, Inspecteur Général des Programmes et Méthodes d'Enseignement et de Formation, a souhaité des échanges francs, constructifs et porteurs d'espoir pour le pays. Chaque administration a présenté son terrain d'action. Le MINESEC et le MINEDUB misent sur l'éducation civique et morale à l'école, les activités périscolaires et le renforcement du civisme. La Gendarmerie Nationale et la Police Nationale rappellent leur mission de sécurisation des personnes et des biens, appuyée par la sensibilisation contre les violences. Le Conseil National de la Jeunesse (CNJC) a mis en avant sa plateforme de dialogue où les jeunes sont consultés sur les féminicides et les violences de tout genre. Du côté de la société civile, Local Youth Corner a présenté l'Agenda Jeunesse, Paix et Sécurité et son concept « N'a We We Jamboree », appelé à s'étendre aux dix régions. NewSETA a rappelé son travail de promotion des valeurs de paix et de démocratie depuis 2013, tandis que Women in Alternative Actions a cité son camp national de la paix et son programme « Queens for Peace ». Depuis le Mexique, le Dr Nsoh Joseph, Ambassadeur du PARI-JEDI, a souligné que la paix se construit d'abord dans la famille. L'UNESCO, pour sa part, a résumé l'approche onusienne autour de l'autonomisation des jeunes, des femmes et de la lutte contre la désinformation. Un consensus : la paix se bâtit chaque jour, à l'école, dans la famille et dans la diaspora. Cet article Journée Internationale de la Paix : le Cameroun mise sur le dialogue pour investir dans la paix au quotidien est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .

data.title: Décentralisation : l’ARC et les CVUC scellent un partenariat historique à Garoua
data.description: © DR En marge de leur Assemblée générale tenue du 14 au 16 septembre 2026 à Garoua, l'Association des Régions du Cameroun (ARC) et les Communes et Villes Unies du Cameroun (CVUC) ont signé un partenariat. Un accord majeur pour porter d'une seule voix la cause des Collectivités Territoriales Décentralisées. C'est une avancée significative pour la décentralisation au Cameroun. Réunies à Garoua le 15 septembre 2026, l'Association des Régions du Cameroun (ARC) et les Communes et Villes Unies du Cameroun (CVUC) ont officialisé leur alliance. La signature est intervenue en marge de l'Assemblée générale de l'ARC, tenue du 14 au 16 septembre dans la capitale régionale du Nord. Une cérémonie hautement symbolique, placée sous le mentorat du Ministre de la Décentralisation et du Développement Local, présent durant l'ensemble des assises, aux côtés de plusieurs autorités administratives et traditionnelles de la région. Cette collaboration, mûrie de longue date, vise à renforcer la synergie entre les deux échelons des Collectivités Territoriales Décentralisées. L'objectif est clair : favoriser une représentation commune des CTD lors des grands événements nationaux et internationaux, et mener des actions de plaidoyer concertées lorsque les enjeux sont partagés. Au-delà du symbole, le partenariat traduit une volonté politique forte de mutualiser les forces, de renforcer le dialogue entre communes et régions, et de rendre plus audible la voix des territoires face à l'État central. Dans un contexte où la décentralisation s'impose comme un pilier de la gouvernance locale, cette union ARC-CVUC apparaît comme un levier essentiel pour accélérer le transfert effectif des compétences et des ressources, et faire progresser durablement le développement local au Cameroun. Cet article Décentralisation : l’ARC et les CVUC scellent un partenariat historique à Garoua est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Decentralization: ARC and CVUC seal a historic partnership in Garoua
data.translatedDescription: © DR On the sidelines of their General Assembly held from September 14 to 16, 2026 in Garoua, the Association of Regions of Cameroon (ARC) and the United Communes and Cities of Cameroon (CVUC) signed a partnership. A major agreement to carry with one voice the cause of Decentralized Territorial Communities. This is a significant step forward for decentralization in Cameroon. Meeting in Garoua on September 15, 2026, the Association of Regions of Cameroon (ARC) and the United Communes and Cities of Cameroon (CVUC) formalized their alliance. The signing took place on the sidelines of the ARC General Assembly, held from September 14 to 16 in the northern regional capital. A highly symbolic ceremony, placed under the mentorship of the Minister of Decentralization and Local Development, present during the entire meeting, alongside several administrative and traditional authorities of the region. This long-term collaboration aims to strengthen the synergy between the two levels of Decentralized Territorial Authorities. The objective is clear: to promote common representation of the CTDs during major national and international events, and to carry out concerted advocacy actions when the issues are shared. Beyond the symbol, the partnership reflects a strong political desire to pool forces, to strengthen dialogue between municipalities and regions, and to make the voice of the territories more audible in the face of the central State. In a context where decentralization is essential as a pillar of local governance, this ARC-CVUC union appears to be an essential lever to accelerate the effective transfer of skills and resources, and to sustainably advance local development in Cameroon. This article Decentralization: ARC and CVUC seal a historic partnership in Garoua appeared first on Journalducameroun.com.

data.translatedDescription: The lack of water, soap and hygiene materials complicates infection prevention and control in some health facilities in Beni, North Kivu. This situation concerns health professionals, while compliance with hygiene measures constitutes an element of the safety of patients and nursing staff.

data.title: Incendies à répétition en RDC :  Quelles solutions pour mieux protéger la population ?

Face à cette situation, une question se pose : comment mieux prévenir ces drames et protéger les populations ? Quelles sont les principales causes de ces incendies à répétition ?

Faced with this situation, a question arises: how can we better prevent these tragedies and protect populations? What are the main causes of these repeated fires?

data.title: Mahama orders review of SHS menu as Education Minister assures students of adequate food
data.description:
Education Minister Haruna Iddrisu has assured Senior High School (SHS) students across the country that adequate provisions have been made for their meals as schools reopen for the 2026/2027 academic year.

He also announced that President John Dramani Mahama has directed a review of the SHS menu to improve the quality of meals served to students.

Mr Iddrisu made the announcement during a visit to Tarkwa Senior High School on Friday, September 18, as students returned to school.

“I will follow further to examine the data and then we’ll ensure that you don’t lack food. We make adequate provision for your meals. I’m happy to announce that President Mahama has directed that we review your menu to make it better,” he said.

The assurance comes amid efforts by the government to address challenges associated with feeding under the Free SHS programme.
