data.title: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
data.description:
US President Donald Trump has announced that he is "immediately" banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House, the latest twist in his fraught relationship with media outlets.

In a post on Truth Social on Friday, Trump said that the outlets "constantly write or report fiction or lies" about his administration, although he provided no examples.

Trump later called it a "very simple ban", but did not explain how it would work.It is unclear whether employees of those outlets would be prevented from entering the White House grounds.

CNN swiftly slammed the move as an "illegal assault" on American press freedoms. The move by Trump is likely to be met with legal challenges.

Reporters from both Politico and CNN were still on the White House grounds shortly after the announcement was made.

A crew from CNN was also travelling with Vice-President JD Vance to and from an event in Iowa.

data.title: Government reviews GH¢25,000 citizenship fee after diaspora concerns
data.description:
The government is reviewing the GH¢25,000 fee for acquiring Ghanaian citizenship following concerns from members of the diaspora that the cost could discourage people from formalising their ties with the country.

Director of the Diaspora Affairs Office of the President, Kofi Okyere Darko, said the matter had already been raised with the Minister for the Interior and would be considered through the appropriate process.

He said government did not want the cost of citizenship to become a barrier for members of the diaspora seeking to establish formal ties with Ghana.

“We didn’t want to relegate or shelve citizenship because of that amount, but quite a number of the people in the diaspora family are not happy with it. So I’ve spoken with the Minister in charge of Interior for us to look at that amount again,” he said.

The issue was raised during a diaspora engagement meeting in Accra, where participants discussed citizenship, investment and efforts to deepen Ghana’s relationship with its historic diaspora.

data.title: Leadership Skills and Public Policy Priorities for Inclusive and Resilient Africa: An integrated Ubuntu perspective
data.description:
This paper utilizes the 2014-2016 Ebola virus disease outbreak as a case study to examine how leadership skills and public policy grounded in the philosophy of Ubuntu can drive inclusive and resilient public policy choices and priorities in Africa. 

Using a multi-disciplinary perspective that intersects leadership, human resources management, organizational design, philosophy, anthropology, political science, and change management models, the research introduces the Ubuntu Leadership Onion and a five-pillar leadership skills framework that serves as a practical tool for developing leaders focused on community, empathy, impact, courage and stakeholder value.

data.title: NCD burden rising as Ghana struggles with prevention, awareness and long-term care – Health Expert
data.description:
Ghana is facing a growing burden of non-communicable diseases (NCDs), with low public awareness, unhealthy lifestyles and challenges in long-term disease management complicating efforts to provide safe care, according to Dr Efua Commeh, Municipal Director of Health at La Nkwantanang-Madina in the Greater Accra region.

She said although infectious diseases remained prevalent, chronic conditions appeared to be increasingly overtaking them, requiring a stronger response from the health system and greater public awareness of NCD risk factors.

Dr Commeh was speaking during a panel discussion held as part of the 2026 World Patient Safety Day celebrations on the theme “Safe Care for Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs).”

data.title: Ninani Group staff take part in health walk, football and games at annual wellness programme
data.description:
After hours of staring at screens, chasing deadlines and working through demanding briefs, employees of the Ninani Group recently traded their office routines for football, racing, table tennis and a health walk.

The annual wellness programme brought together staff from the group’s six marketing communications agencies — Results Advertising, Innova DDB, Interactive Digital, Touchpoint Magna Carta, Brand Alert and P2P.

But for the organisers, the event was about more than competition and trophies. It was an opportunity for employees to step away from their desks, reconnect with colleagues and pay attention to their physical wellbeing.

Chief Operating Officer of Results Advertising, Justin Antwi-Darkwa, said the initiative was designed to give staff a break from the demands of work.

data.title: Ghana needs national dialogue to end political insult culture — Kpebu
data.description:
Private legal practitioner Martin Kpebu has called for a national dialogue on Ghana’s growing culture of political insults, arguing that arrests and prosecutions alone will not resolve the problem.

Speaking on Joy FM’s Top Story, Mr Kpebu said the controversy surrounding the “Ghana Jollof” TikTok account had exposed a broader problem with political discourse in the country that required collective action.

“The first thing I’m curious about is that we all want this menace of insults against politicians and other people in society to stop. That culture of vitriol, we want to control the vitriol. It’s getting out of hand,” he said.

Mr Kpebu acknowledged that the problem cuts across Ghana’s political divide, saying political actors and commentators on different sides have at various times used language that could be considered offensive.

data.title: ‘Relax, I’m not contesting you in 2028’ — DVLA CEO tells Zanetor
data.description:
Chief Executive Officer of the Driver and Vehicle Licensing Authority (DVLA), Julius Neequaye Kotey, has dismissed speculation that he is preparing to challenge Klottey Korle MP Dr Zanetor Agyeman-Rawlings in the 2028 parliamentary election.

Speaking on Starr FM, Mr Neequaye Kotey said that although he has the right to contest the constituency if he chooses to, he has not decided to do so in 2028.

“If I’m eyeing that seat, it’s not against any law. I have the right to contest for that seat,” he said.

He added: “For now, I have not made up my mind, so Dr Zanetor should relax. The way she is going around, she should relax. I am not going to contest her.”

data.title: Insurance sector offers huge job opportunities as Ghana faces actuarial skills shortage — GIU Rector
data.description:
The insurance industry offers significant employment opportunities for young people, particularly in specialised fields such as actuarial science and statistics, Rector of the Ghana Insurance University College (GIU), Dr Richard Okyere, has said.

He urged WASSCE graduates and other young people with strong interests in mathematics, data and analytical work to consider careers in insurance, saying the sector continues to face a shortage of skilled professionals.

Dr Okyere said Ghana’s low insurance penetration also presented considerable room for growth, creating opportunities for professionals who can help expand the industry and manage increasingly complex financial risks.

“Low insurance penetration implies huge opportunity to grow with high demand for manpower,” he said.

He made the comments while speaking about the admission process and programmes offered by GIU, which was inaugurated earlier this year as a higher education institution focused on developing professionals for Ghana’s insurance and financial sectors.

Dr Okyere said GIU has a distinctive advantage because it is owned by players in the insurance industry, allowing it to maintain a direct link between professional practice and academic training.

He made the comments while speaking about the admission process and programmes offered by GIU, which was inaugurated earlier this year as a higher education institution focused on developing professionals for Ghana’s insurance and financial sectors.

Dr Okyere said GIU has a distinctive advantage because it is owned by players in the insurance industry, allowing it to maintain a direct link between professional practice and academic training.

data.title: Newsfile to discuss Ghana Jollof nurse case, cocaine shipment, COVID audit and constitutional reforms
data.description:
JoyNews’ flagship current affairs programme, Newsfile, will on Saturday, September 19, 2026, examine four major national issues that have dominated public discourse over the past week.

Hosted by Samson Lardy Anyenini, the programme will air from 8:00am to 12:00pm on Joy 99.7 FM, JoyNews and other platforms.

Ghana Jollof case and the free speech debate

The programme will examine the arrest and remand of 40-year-old senior nursing officer Salomey Awiti Bafoh over her alleged links to the controversial “Ghana Jollof” TikTok account.

Ms Bafoh was arrested at her home in Hansua, near Techiman, on September 13 and later appeared before the Adentan Circuit Court, where she pleaded not guilty to a charge of abetment of crime, specifically the alleged publication and circulation of false news under Sections 20(1) and 208 of the Criminal Offences Act, 1960 (Act 29). She was denied bail and remanded for two weeks, with the case adjourned to September 30.

data.title: CPP urges Ghanaians to revive Nkrumah’s vision of self-reliance and industrialisation
data.description:
The General Secretary of the Convention People’s Party (CPP), Harold Stephen Ato Eshun, has called on Ghanaians to renew their commitment to Dr Kwame Nkrumah’s vision of economic independence, industrialisation and African unity.

He said persistent challenges including unemployment, corruption, economic difficulties, inequality and abandoned projects should prompt the country to critically examine how effectively it controls its resources and determines its economic future.

Mr Eshun made the call ahead of Dr Nkrumah’s 117th birthday on Monday, September 21, saying the occasion should go beyond remembering Ghana’s first President to examining how his ideas could be applied to present-day development challenges.

He said Nkrumah’s vision extended beyond Ghana’s independence from colonial rule to the political and economic emancipation of Africa.

data.title: Bagbin re-inaugurates African Commission of Health and Human Rights Promoters with GH¢100,000 donation
data.description:
Speaker of Parliament, Rt. Hon. Alban Kingsford Bagbin, has formally re-inaugurated the African Commission of Health and Human Rights Promoters and launched its Endowment Fund with a personal contribution of GH¢100,000.

The event, held at the Labadi Beach Hotel in Accra on Thursday, September 17, marked the revival of the Commission, which is seeking to renew its work around healthcare rights, human dignity, accountability and the protection of vulnerable and marginalised groups.

The Commission’s founder, Naa Professor Edmund Nminyem Delle, said its origins date back to 1989, when it was established to respond to human rights concerns surrounding HIV/AIDS and discrimination against people living with the disease.

Professor Delle said its work later expanded to supporting people fleeing persecution and torture, including journalists and others who sought refuge in Ghana.

However, he said the organisation’s activities eventually slowed because of financial constraints, prompting efforts to establish a new foundation for its work.

data.title: ZUYUS raises the stakes with new release ‘Million Billion’
data.description:
With his latest release, ‘Million Billion’, the artist takes his ambition to another level, delivering a bold, visually driven record about money, sacrifice, persistence and the relentless desire to keep building. Stream or download ‘Million Billion’ across all major digital platforms here: https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/zuyus/million-billion

Directed by Bra Shizzle, the music video brings the song’s larger-than-life aspirations to life through striking imagery and an unapologetic celebration of wealth. From its opening frames, where hundreds of dollars are spread across the scene, the video establishes its central theme immediately: money is not simply a symbol of luxury, but the physical representation of a goal ZUYUS is determined to chase. Throughout the video, ZUYUS leans into extravagant and unexpected imagery, including scenes of a lady cooking with dollars and even feeding them to his child. The surreal visuals amplify the song’s message, turning the idea of wealth into something almost tangible while reflecting the scale of the ambition expressed throughout the record.

ZUYUS makes no secret of the level of success he is pursuing. References to figures such as Bill Gates, Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk underscore a desire for wealth on an extraordinary scale, while the recurring idea of turning “a million into a billion” becomes the driving philosophy of the song.

data.title: Salud reporta aumento en casos de sarampión, dengue, miasis y tos ferina en Honduras
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras. La Secretaría de Salud ( Sesal ) mantiene bajo vigilancia el comportamiento de cuatro enfermedades que registran un incremento de casos durante 2026: dengue, sarampión, miasis por gusano barrenador y tos ferina. Estas forman parte de las 65 Enfermedades de Notificación Obligatoria (ENO) monitoreadas en Honduras. En el caso del dengue, el registro de la Sesal acumula 8,970 casos sospechosos y 8,825 notificados hasta el cierre de agosto de 2026. De este último grupo, 145 pacientes desarrollaron una condición grave. Francisco Morazán concentra la mayor cantidad de reportes, principalmente en el Distrito Central, con 8,970 casos. Le siguen Cortés, con 606 casos en San Pedro Sula, y Olancho, con 585. La Organización Panamericana de la Salud ( OPS ) señala que la mosca asociada con la miasis por gusano barrenador tiene una coloración azulada y un tamaño de entre 10 y 15 milímetros. El insecto se encuentra exclusivamente en el continente americano y es considerado un parásito obligado, debido a que requiere de un huésped para reproducirse y alimentarse. El sarampión también forma parte de las enfermedades prevenibles mediante vacunación que son objeto de seguimiento sanitario. De acuerdo con el reporte citado, la cobertura de vacunación en el territorio nacional alcanza el 60%, una situación que requiere atención para reducir el riesgo de propagación de enfermedades que pueden prevenirse mediante la inmunización. Tras permanecer inactivo durante 29 años en el país, el sarampión registra casos confirmados nuevamente en 2026. El reporte contabiliza 14 casos confirmados, aunque el desglose consignado señala ocho contagios locales y siete procedentes de Guatemala, cifras que deben ser verificadas porque presentan una diferencia de un caso. La vacunación es una de las principales medidas de prevención. El esquema señalado contempla una primera dosis al cumplir un año de edad y una segunda dosis, considerada de refuerzo, a los 18 meses o a los seis años. La tos ferina constituye otra de las enfermedades que muestran un incremento durante este año. Según el reporte citado, 19 menores de edad han fallecido a causa de esta infección. Entre las víctimas más recientes se encuentran dos bebés, de dos meses y 40 días de nacidos. En lo que va de 2026 se han confirmado 250 casos, más del doble de los 114 registrados durante todo 2025. La OPS describe la tos ferina como una infección bacteriana altamente contagiosa que afecta el tracto respiratorio y que es provocada por las bacterias Bordetella pertussis o Bordetella parapertussis. La protección contra esta enfermedad comienza desde el embarazo, con la vacunación de la madre, según la información incluida en el reporte. Esta medida busca brindar protección al recién nacido durante sus primeros meses de vida. Después del nacimiento, el esquema de inmunización contempla dosis a los 2, 4, 6 y 18 meses, además de una última aplicación a los 4 años.
data.translatedTitle: Health reports increase in cases of measles, dengue, myiasis and whooping cough in Honduras
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras. The Ministry of Health (Sesal) keeps under surveillance the behavior of four diseases that register an increase in cases during 2026: dengue, measles, screwworm myiasis and whooping cough. These are part of the 65 Notifiable Diseases (NOD) monitored in Honduras. In the case of dengue, the Sesal registry accumulates 8,970 suspected cases and 8,825 notified until the end of August 2026. Of this last group, 145 patients developed a serious condition. Francisco Morazán concentrates the largest number of reports, mainly in the Central District, with 8,970 cases. They are followed by Cortés, with 606 cases in San Pedro Sula, and Olancho, with 585. The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) indicates that the fly associated with screwworm myiasis has a bluish color and a size of between 10 and 15 millimeters. The insect is found exclusively on the American continent and is considered an obligate parasite, because it requires a host to reproduce and feed. Measles is also one of the vaccine-preventable diseases that are subject to health monitoring. According to the cited report, vaccination coverage in the national territory reaches 60%, a situation that requires attention to reduce the risk of spread of diseases that can be prevented through immunization. After remaining inactive for 29 years in the country, measles registers confirmed cases again in 2026. The report counts 14 confirmed cases, although the breakdown indicates eight local infections and seven from Guatemala, figures that must be verified because they present a difference of one case. Vaccination is one of the main prevention measures. The indicated scheme includes a first dose at one year of age and a second dose, considered a booster, at 18 months or six years. Whooping cough is another of the diseases that show an increase this year. According to the aforementioned report, 19 minors have died due to this infection. Among the most recent victims are two babies, two months and 40 days old. So far in 2026, 250 cases have been confirmed, more than double the 114 recorded throughout 2025. PAHO describes whooping cough as a highly contagious bacterial infection that affects the respiratory tract and is caused by the bacteria Bordetella pertussis or Bordetella parapertussis. Protection against this disease begins during pregnancy, with the mother's vaccination, according to the information included in the report. This measure seeks to provide protection to the newborn during the first months of life. After birth, the immunization schedule includes doses at 2, 4, 6 and 18 months, in addition to a last application at 4 years.

data.title: ¿Qué es el sargazo y como está afectando las bellas playas de Omoa?
data.description: San Pedro Sula, Honduras. Mientras Omoa se prepara para la llegada de visitantes que espera recibir durante la Semana Morazánica, otro visitante no deseado se ha hecho presente: el sargazo. Traídas por la corriente, esta clase de algas hizo su aparición desde hace dos días en las playas de este municipio del litoral caribe hondureño, sin embargo, no es primera vez que arriba a las playas. Pronunciándose sobre este problema que ha plagado en tiempos recientes a Omoa, el alcalde, Ricardo Alvarado reconoció que “el sargazo es una preocupación latente” y agrega que, debido a esto “tenemos bastante trabajo para mantener limpias las playas”. La llegada del sargazo a Omoa no solo afecta el disfrute de quienes visitan sus playas, sino también a los pescadores artesanales, que ven entorpecida su labor, dificultándoles la faena. Blas Luján, quien fungió como inspector de caza y pesca en Omoa, citado por medios de comunicación, indicó que se trata de algo “impactante”, nunca antes visto, por lo que hizo un llamado a las autoridades que apoyen de manera urgente la tarea de recolección y limpieza. Pescadores locales señalaron que, debido al efecto de las corrientes marinas, la capa de algas que cubre las aguas del mar podría llegar incluso más al este, hasta las playas cerca de Puerto Cortés. Consultado sobre la preparación del municipio de para enfrentar esta clase de contingencias, el alcalde Alvarado dice que las autoridades han unido esfuerzos con otras fuerzas del municipio, agrupadas alrededor de las cámaras de comercio y de turismo, con el objetivo de formar cuadrillas que se encarguen de las labores de recolección y limpieza, a fin de mantener limpias las playas y las aguas circundantes. “Tenemos suficiente personal y aquí con la Cámara de Comercio, Cámara de Turismo, la misma municipalidad, pues nos unimos, unimos esfuerzo para que el turista se sienta cómodo”, acotó Alvarado. La constante llegada de sargazo a Omoa, además de trastornar el desarrollo normas de las actividades comerciales, turísticas y de pesca, provoca pérdidas económicas, sin que hasta ahora se haya implementado una solución duradera al problema. En agosto, el gobierno de Honduras articuló una mesa interinstitucional para brindar una respuesta al impacto del sargazo, basada en una estrategia que no solo incluye limpieza de playas, sino también acciones de prevención, monitoreo, contención, recolección y aprovechamiento responsable del sargazo como biomasa. El sargazo es un alga marina parda que flota libremente en la superficie del océano y puede formar grandes mantos. En mar abierto cumple una función ecológica importante, porque sirve de refugio, alimento y zona de reproducción para peces, tortugas y otras especies. El problema surge cuando grandes cantidades son arrastradas por los vientos y las corrientes hacia las costas. Desde 2011, este fenómeno se ha vuelto recurrente en el Caribe debido a la expansión del llamado Gran Cinturón de Sargazo del Atlántico , que transporta enormes masas de estas algas hacia el mar Caribe y Centroamérica. Cuando el sargazo se acumula en las playas puede generar impactos ambientales y económicos. Grandes concentraciones dificultan la navegación y las labores de pesca, cubren zonas costeras y pueden alterar ecosistemas marinos poco profundos. Además, al descomponerse consume oxígeno del agua y libera gases, principalmente sulfuro de hidrógeno, responsable del fuerte olor característico. En comunidades costeras del Caribe estas arribazones también afectan el turismo, porque reducen la calidad de las playas y obligan a invertir en limpieza y disposición del material acumulado. NOAA advierte que los episodios masivos pueden afectar simultáneamente la pesca, el turismo, la navegación y los ecosistemas costeros. En Honduras , el Caribe ya ha registrado episodios importantes de sargazo, especialmente en Islas de la Bahía y otras zonas de la costa norte. Este viernes 18 de septiembre se reportaron acumulaciones considerables en Omoa, Cortés , donde pescadores han advertido dificultades para sus actividades y preocupación por la posible llegada del material hacia Puerto Cortés. Este 2026 ha sido un año excepcional para el sargazo : la Nasa informó que en junio el Gran Cinturón del Atlántico alcanzó niveles cercanos a récord y que tanto el Caribe como el Golfo registraron cantidades históricamente altas.
data.translatedTitle: What is sargassum and how is it affecting the beautiful beaches of Omoa?
data.translatedDescription: San Pedro Sula, Honduras. While Omoa prepares for the arrival of visitors it hopes to receive during the Morazan Week, another unwanted visitor has been present: sargassum. Brought by the current, this type of algae appeared two days ago on the beaches of this municipality on the Honduran Caribbean coast; however, it is not the first time it has arrived on the beaches. Speaking about this problem that has plagued Omoa in recent times, the mayor, Ricardo Alvarado, acknowledged that “sargassum is a latent concern” and added that, because of this, “we have a lot of work to keep the beaches clean.” The arrival of sargassum to Omoa not only affects the enjoyment of those who visit its beaches, but also the artisanal fishermen, who see their work hindered, making their work difficult. Blas Luján, who served as hunting and fishing inspector in Omoa, quoted by the media, indicated that this is something “shocking”, never seen before, which is why he called on the authorities to urgently support the task of collection and cleaning. Local fishermen pointed out that, due to the effect of marine currents, the layer of algae that covers the sea waters could reach even further east, to the beaches near Puerto Cortés. Asked about the municipality's preparation to face this type of contingencies, Mayor Alvarado says that the authorities have joined forces with other forces in the municipality, grouped around the chambers of commerce and tourism, with the aim of forming crews to be in charge of collection and cleaning tasks, in order to keep the beaches and surrounding waters clean. “We have enough staff and here with the Chamber of Commerce, Chamber of Tourism, the municipality itself, we unite, we join efforts so that the tourist feels comfortable,” Alvarado said. The constant arrival of sargassum to Omoa, in addition to disrupting the normal development of commercial, tourist and fishing activities, causes economic losses, without a lasting solution to the problem having been implemented so far. In August, the government of Honduras articulated an inter-institutional table to provide a response to the impact of sargassum, based on a strategy that not only includes beach cleaning, but also prevention, monitoring, containment, collection and responsible use of sargassum as biomass. Sargassum is a brown seaweed that floats freely on the ocean surface and can form large mats. In the open sea it fulfills an important ecological function, because it serves as a refuge, food and reproduction area for fish, turtles and other species. The problem arises when large quantities are carried by winds and currents towards the coasts. Since 2011, this phenomenon has become recurrent in the Caribbean due to the expansion of the so-called Great Atlantic Sargassum Belt, which transports enormous masses of these algae to the Caribbean Sea and Central America. When sargassum accumulates on beaches it can generate environmental and economic impacts. Large concentrations make navigation and fishing difficult, cover coastal areas and can alter shallow marine ecosystems. Furthermore, when it decomposes it consumes oxygen from the water and releases gases, mainly hydrogen sulfide, responsible for the strong characteristic odor. In Caribbean coastal communities, these landfalls also affect tourism, because they reduce the quality of the beaches and force investment in cleaning and disposal of the accumulated material. NOAA warns that massive episodes can simultaneously affect fishing, tourism, shipping and coastal ecosystems. In Honduras, the Caribbean has already recorded important sargassum episodes, especially in the Bay Islands and other areas of the northern coast. This Friday, September 18, considerable accumulations were reported in Omoa, Cortés, where fishermen have warned of difficulties in their activities and concern about the possible arrival of material towards Puerto Cortés. This 2026 has been an exceptional year for sargassum: NASA reported that in June the Great Atlantic Belt reached near-record levels and that both the Caribbean and the Gulf recorded historically high quantities.

data.title: Lobos UPN se lleva un triunfazo de Puerto Cortés y deja hundido al Platense
data.description: El Platense de Raúl Cáceres sufrió este viernes su quinta derrota del Torneo Apertura 2026 . El 'Tiburón' cayó en el Estadio Excélsior de Puerto Cortés contra Lobos de la UPNFM (0-2) en el duelo correspondiente a la octava jornada. El conjunto escualo atraviesa un momento complicado con solo un triunfo y dos empates que lo sitúan en la décima posición de la tabla con cinco puntos, mientras que la 'Manada' consigue su segunda victoria del torneo y sigue como noveno con ocho unidades. Platense dominó durante los primeros minutos del encuentro y hasta perdonó varias ocasiones para abrir el marcador. Eduardo Urbina, Georgie Welcome y Cristian 'Pin' Gutiérrez lo intentaron pero sin suerte. Pese a la insistencia del cuadro local, fueron los Lobos quienes silenciaron el Excélsior con la ley del ex. Daniel Carter Bodden , exjugador del 'Tiburón', hizo el 0-1 con un remate de cabeza a los 23 minutos, después de aprovechar el centro de Omar 'Burrito' Elvir . Tras el tanto inicial, la UPN empezó a tener la posesión frente a un Platense que no logró asentarse en el campo defensivo, lo que provocó el segundo de la tarde para la visita con un golazo de Samuel Elvir . El mediocampista de 25 años metió un derechazo al ángulo desde fuera del área al 34' que fue imposible de contener para el portero Manuel Loaiza que solo voló para la fotografía. Para la segunda mitad, Platense no bajaba los brazos en busca del descuento, pero la defensa visitante y su arquero Alex Naid Güity se mostraban sólidos contrarrestando cualquier ataque. Lo más destacado fue un tremendo remate de Avner Portillo que Güity desvió al córner. Gran intervención del guardameta para evitar el tanto escualo en el 68'. Welcome , autor de un golazo en la fecha anterior ante Estrella Roja , tuvo un partido para el olvido y fue sustituido por Jeffrey Brooks , que tampoco sobresalió cuando lo necesitaba su equipo. La serie histórica entre Platense y la UPN en la Liga Nacional es una de las más parejas desde que el cuadro universitario ascendió en el 2017. Con el marcador de este tarde, la 'Manada' igualó a los escualos con ocho victorias cada uno y ocho empates en 24 presentaciones. Jugando específicamente en el Estadio Excélsior, el 'Tiburón' mantenía una paternidad muy marcada sobre la UPN . En los últimos enfrentamientos arrastraba una racha positiva, incluyendo goleadas contundentes de 4-1 en las temporadas previas. Esta tarde la historia fue a favor de los dirigidos por Salomón Nazar . La próxima cita para Platense será nuevamente de local contra el Juticalpa y la UPN intentará sorprender a Marathón en Choluteca. 0 - PLATENSE: 28. Manuel Loaiza; 2. data.translatedTitle: Lobos UPN takes a great victory from Puerto Cortés and leaves Platense sunk
data.translatedDescription: Raúl Cáceres's Platense suffered its fifth defeat of the 2026 Apertura Tournament this Friday. The 'Shark' fell at the Excélsior Stadium in Puerto Cortés against Lobos of the UPNFM (0-2) in the duel corresponding to the eighth day. The team is going through a difficult time with only one win and two draws that place it in tenth position in the table with five points, while the 'Manada' achieves its second victory of the tournament and remains ninth with eight points. Platense dominated during the first minutes of the match and even gave up several chances to open the scoring. Eduardo Urbina, Georgie Welcome and Cristian 'Pin' Gutiérrez tried but without luck. Despite the insistence of the local team, it was the Wolves who silenced the Excélsior with the law of the former. Daniel Carter Bodden, former 'Tiburón' player, made it 0-1 with a header in the 23rd minute, after taking advantage of Omar 'Burrito' Elvir's cross. After the initial goal, UPN began to have possession against a Platense that failed to establish itself in the defensive field, which led to the second of the afternoon for the visit with a great goal from Samuel Elvir. The 25-year-old midfielder hit a right-footed shot into the corner from outside the area in the 34th minute that was impossible to contain for goalkeeper Manuel Loaiza, who only flew for the photograph. For the second half, Platense did not lower its arms in search of the discount, but the visiting defense and its goalkeeper Alex Naid Güity were solid, counteracting any attack. The highlight was a tremendous shot by Avner Portillo that Güity deflected into the corner. Great intervention by the goalkeeper to avoid the goal in the 68th minute. Welcome, author of a great goal the previous day against Red Star, had a game to forget and was replaced by Jeffrey Brooks, who also did not stand out when his team needed him. The historical series between Platense and the UPN in the National League is one of the most even since the university team was promoted in 2017. With this afternoon's score, the 'Manada' equaled the sharks with eight wins each and eight draws in 24 appearances. Playing specifically at the Excélsior Stadium, the 'Tiburón' maintained a very marked paternity over the UPN. In the last matches they had a positive streak, including resounding 4-1 wins in previous seasons. This afternoon the story was in favor of those led by Salomón Nazar. data.title: No hay registro de que Manuel Zelaya lamentara sanción a Nasralla ni que hablara del Partido Liberal
data.description: Circula en redes sociales una publicación que atribuye al expresidente de Honduras (2006-2009) Manuel Zelaya una supuesta declaración en la que lamenta la sanción económica impuesta al excandidato presidencial del Partido Liberal, Salvador Nasralla, por la Unidad de Financiamiento, Transparencia y Fiscalización a Partidos Políticos y Candidatos (UFTF) y asegura que ese instituto político le está dando la espalda. Sin embargo, esto es falso. No hay registros públicos que demuestren que el exmandatario haya pronunciado o publicado esa declaración, según constató LA PRENSA Verifica mediante búsquedas en medios de comunicación y en sus cuentas oficiales. “El comandante desde su lecho en recuperación ha dicho, ya estamos en recuperación, pero quiero acotar algo, y decirles que Salvador Nasralla no sabe nada de política hombre, es el señor de la televisión, es un gran narrador deportivo que hasta yo lo aplaudo cuando lo escucho narrar los partidos en el estadio. No sé quién lo ha engañado que es un gran político, lo siento mucho por la multa millonaria que le pusieron, y el partido Liberal le está dando la espalda, eso significa que no lo quieren, en Libre lo queríamos, lo teníamos bien, en eso se puso a loquear como que era X-0 y tuvimos que expulsarlo”, dice parte de la publicación difundida en Facebook, compartida decenas de veces desde el 18 de septiembre de 2026. La Unidad de Financiamiento, Transparencia y Fiscalización a Partidos Políticos y Candidatos (UFTF), conocida como Política Limpia, impuso una multa de 146,457,720 lempiras a Salvador Nasralla por irregularidades detectadas durante la fiscalización de los informes financieros de su campaña presidencial de 2025. Según la UFTF, las inconsistencias están relacionadas con 21 aportaciones privadas que sumaron 73,228,860 lempiras y que no fueron subsanadas en tiempo y forma. La sanción equivale al doble de ese monto. La institución determinó que los formatos correspondientes a esas aportaciones fueron presentados de manera extemporánea y precisó que su incorporación posterior para efectos de fiscalización documental no elimina la infracción ni la sanción. La presidenta de la UFTF, Ivonne Ardón, explicó que el responsable financiero de Nasralla fue notificado sobre los hallazgos y presentó descargos y documentación. Sin embargo, señaló que algunas inconsistencias no fueron subsanadas durante el procedimiento de fiscalización. Nasralla, por su parte, aseguró que presentó su informe financiero en tiempo y forma y sostuvo que los cuestionamientos corresponden a asuntos administrativos y documentales. También aseguró que recurrirá a las instancias correspondientes para controvertir la decisión. El excandidato también declaró que, desde su perspectiva, existen sectores dentro del Partido Liberal y del Partido Nacional interesados en impedir su participación política de cara a las elecciones de 2029. Por su parte, Manuel Zelaya se encuentra en México, donde continúa su proceso de recuperación y seguimiento médico. El exmandatario viajó a ese país el 7 de septiembre de 2026, después de ser sometido a una intervención quirúrgica en Tegucigalpa. Una búsqueda con las palabras clave “Manuel Zelaya + lamentar sanción + Salvador Nasralla + UFTF” no permitió localizar entrevistas ni reportes de medios de comunicación que documenten que el exmandatario hondureño haya realizado esas declaraciones. También se realizaron búsquedas de la declaración en distintos motores de búsqueda y redes sociales, pero no se encontraron resultados más allá de la publicación viral. Esto indica que no existen registros públicos de que el contenido haya sido difundido de forma oficial ni replicado por fuentes confiables. La publicación viral presenta las palabras como una declaración de Zelaya, pero no incluye un video, audio, entrevista, comunicado u otra fuente primaria que permita comprobar que fueron pronunciadas por el exmandatario. De igual manera, se revisó la cuenta de X de Manuel Zelaya y no se encontró ninguna publicación en la que se refiera a la sanción impuesta a Nasralla en los términos que aparecen en la publicación viral. Una fuente cercana a Zelaya confirmó a LA PRENSA Verifica que el exgobernante no ha emitido una opinión referente al tema. “No ha dado declaraciones me confirman”, aclaró. Por lo tanto, no hay registros públicos que respalden la cita atribuida al expresidente Manuel Zelaya sobre la sanción impuesta a Salvador Nasralla y la supuesta posición del Partido Liberal.
data.translatedTitle: There is no record that Manuel Zelaya regretted sanctioning Nasralla or that he spoke about the Liberal Party
data.translatedDescription: A publication is circulating on social networks that attributes to the former president of Honduras (2006-2009) Manuel Zelaya an alleged statement in which he regrets the economic sanction imposed on the former presidential candidate of the Liberal Party, Salvador Nasralla, by the Financing, Transparency and Supervision Unit for Political Parties and Candidates (UFTF) and assures that this political institute is turning its back on him. However, this is false. There are no public records that demonstrate that the former president has uttered or published that statement, as verified by LA PRENSA. Verify through searches in the media and in his official accounts. "The commander from his bed in recovery has said, we are already in recovery, but I want to limit something, and tell you that Salvador Nasralla knows nothing about politics, man, he is the master of television, he is a great sports narrator that even I applaud him when I hear him narrate the games in the stadium. I don't know who has deceived him that he is a great politician, I am very sorry for the million-dollar fine they imposed on him, and the Liberal party is turning its back on him, that means they don't want him, in Libre we wanted him, "we had good, that's when he started to freak out like he was audit of the financial reports of his 2025 presidential campaign. According to the UFTF, the inconsistencies are related to 21 private contributions that totaled 73,228,860 lempiras and that were not corrected in a timely manner. The penalty is equivalent to double that amount. The institution determined that the forms corresponding to these contributions were presented out of time and specified that their subsequent incorporation for the purposes of documentary inspection does not eliminate the infraction or the sanction. The president of the UFTF, Ivonne Ardón, explained that Nasralla's financial officer was notified of the findings and presented defenses and documentation. However, he noted that some inconsistencies were not corrected during the inspection procedure. Nasralla, for his part, assured that he presented his financial report in a timely manner and maintained that the questions correspond to administrative and documentary matters. He also assured that he will appeal to the corresponding authorities to challenge the decision. The former candidate also declared that, from his perspective, there are sectors within the Liberal Party and the National Party interested in preventing his political participation in the face of the 2029 elections. For his part, Manuel Zelaya is in Mexico, where he continues his recovery process and medical follow-up. The former president traveled to that country on September 7, 2026, after undergoing surgery in Tegucigalpa. A search with the keywords “Manuel Zelaya + regret sanction + Salvador Nasralla + UFTF” did not allow us to locate interviews or media reports that document that the former Honduran president made these statements. Searches for the statement were also carried out on different search engines and social networks, but no results were found beyond the viral publication. This indicates that there are no public records that the content has been officially disseminated or replicated by reliable sources. The viral publication presents the words as a statement from Zelaya, but does not include a video, audio, interview, statement or other primary source that allows verification that they were spoken by the former president. Likewise, Manuel Zelaya's X account was reviewed and no publication was found that refers to the sanction imposed on Nasralla in the terms that appear in the viral publication. A source close to Zelaya confirmed to LA PRENSA Verifica that the former ruler has not issued an opinion regarding the issue. “He has not given statements that confirm it,” he clarified. Therefore, there are no public records to support the quote attributed to former President Manuel Zelaya regarding the sanction imposed on Salvador Nasralla and the alleged position of the Liberal Party.

data.title: Pastora relata lo que pasó en las dos horas de oración para sacar “demonios” a jovencitas
data.description: Santa Bárbara, Honduras . Martha Leiva, pastora de la Iglesia Unción de Dios Pentecostés, aseguró que tenía los ojos cerrados cuando Alberto Parra, pastor argentino acusado de violación y otras agresiones sexuales agravadas contra dos menores, oraba por ellas en una vivienda de la comunidad de La Cuchilla, La Arada, Santa Bárbara. La pastora Leiva explicó que llegó a la vivienda aproximadamente a las 7:00 de la mañana y permaneció allí cerca de dos horas, mientras realizaban oraciones por las dos menores. Según su relato, salió del lugar alrededor de las 9:00 de la mañana. “Yo no vi de nada, porque yo tenía los ojos cerrados ”, afirmó en una entrevista a DIARIO LA PRENSA al ser consultada sobre lo ocurrido durante la jornada. Sostuvo que no podía afirmar algo que no hubiera observado y aseguró que su posición no estaba relacionada con la amistad o procedencia del extranjero. “No es porque yo me lleve bien, ni porque sea de donde es, pero no puedo yo decir lo que yo no veo”, manifestó. Agregó que, según lo que ella sí observó, Parra estuvo orando durante ese tiempo . De acuerdo con la denuncia, los hechos que dieron origen a la investigación ocurrieron esa mañana y los actos denunciados no fueron consentidos. La acusación señala que una de las menores habría sido víctima de una agresión sexual y que a la otra supuestamente le realizaron tocamientos y besos. Leiva relató que durante la oración permaneció con los ojos cerrados y que en algunos momentos incluso se colocó de espaldas. “¿Cómo voy a ver lo que está pasando atrás? A veces me hice así en la pared”, explicó. También dijo que, según lo que conoció posteriormente, la madre de una de las menores habría sido quien observó la situación y presentó la denuncia. La pastora describió además el contexto de las oraciones realizadas por Parra en la comunidad. Según su relato, el argentino acudía a diferentes viviendas para orar y ungir casas, mientras algunas personas buscaban su ayuda espiritual. Dijo que en una de esas ocasiones se habló de una mujer que supuestamente tenía un “hechizo” en el estómago . Sobre la permanencia del pastor evangélico Parra en la comunidad, Leiva indicó que llevaba 16 días hospedado allí cuando ocurrieron los hechos denunciados. Aseguró que durante ese período lo observó con un comportamiento que calificó de adecuado. “Bien portado usted, mire que a él hasta estuvo allí orando, solo hablando de Dios”, expresó. La mujer contó que ella le proporcionaba comida, aunque el pastor no acostumbraba comer tortillas. Según explicó, Parra compraba harina y carne molida para preparar hamburguesas y también cocinaba huevos. “Si tengo algo y estoy comiendo, y usted está a tiempo, yo tengo que darle”, dijo al explicar por qué lo alimentaba. Leiva relató que Parra inicialmente se quedó una o dos noches en un espacio de la vivienda y posteriormente permaneció en otro lugar, donde dormía en el suelo sobre un colchón. La pastora afirmó que incluso pensó en acondicionarle un espacio separado para que se quedara, pero él habría rechazado alojarse dentro de su casa. Según Leiva, Parra le manifestó que no quería incomodarla ni irrespetar su matrimonio y que por eso prefería dormir en otro sitio. La pastora agregó que tiene nietas solteras y que observó que el extranjero no se acercaba a ellas cuando estaban solas. “Yo estuve observando”, afirmó al explicar que mantenía esa precaución. La pastora recordó que incluso le había advertido a Parra que, si alguna persona presentaba una queja sobre su comportamiento, tendría que abandonar el lugar. “Si ellos me hubieran puesto quejas, yo le digo: ‘Mire, hermano Alberto, se me va a ir’”, manifestó. Añadió que durante los 16 días que estuvo en la comunidad nadie le había presentado una queja. Leiva también contó que Parra llegó a la comunidad para buscarla a ella porque sabía que realizaba cultos. Según explicó, el argentino le dijo que quería acompañarla a predicar y que necesitaba una “cobertura” religiosa. Ella respondió que primero debían conocerlo, debido a que no era originario de la zona. La pastora aseguró que su esposo también estuvo de acuerdo en apoyarlo y que, durante su permanencia, Parra conversaba principalmente sobre temas religiosos. “Todo el tiempo que estuvo aquí, solo de Dios hablaba”, afirmó. Dijo que cuando una mujer estaba sola, él no se acercaba y que las conversaciones religiosas se realizaban con otras personas presentes. Leiva también relató que Parra decía haber atravesado 12 países para llegar a Honduras y que había viajado sin dinero. La mujer aseguró que lo observó orando por diferentes personas y que, según lo que ella presenció, acudía a viviendas para realizar oraciones. Sobre los señalamientos actuales, sostuvo que será la investigación la que determine lo ocurrido. “Si a él le hallan pruebas de que violó , entonces va preso”, expresó la pastora, quien agregó: “Las máquinas no mienten”, en referencia a los exámenes y pruebas que puedan realizarse. También insistió en que no tiene responsabilidad en los hechos y dijo que permanece en la comunidad porque no considera tener motivos para huir. La pastora explicó que actualmente los cultos de su congregación se realizan cuatro veces por semana: sábado, domingo, martes y jueves. Las personas comienzan a reunirse alrededor de las 6:00 de la tarde y el culto inicia a las 7:00 y termina entre las 8:00 y 9:00 de la noche. También señaló que en el centro de la comunidad existen otras dos iglesias y que el templo donde se congregan aún está en construcción, con unos diez días de trabajos, por lo que proyectan colocar una viga solera alrededor de la estructura.
data.translatedTitle: Pastor tells what happened during the two hours of prayer to remove “demons” from young girls
data.translatedDescription: Santa Barbara, Honduras. Martha Leiva, pastor of the Anointing of God Pentecost Church, assured that she had her eyes closed when Alberto Parra, an Argentine pastor accused of rape and other aggravated sexual assaults against two minors, prayed for them in a home in the community of La Cuchilla, La Arada, Santa Bárbara. Pastor Leiva explained that she arrived at the home at approximately 7:00 in the morning and remained there for about two hours, while they prayed for the two minors. According to his story, he left the place around 9:00 in the morning. “I didn't see anything, because I had my eyes closed,” she stated in an interview with DIARIO LA PRENSA when asked about what happened during the day. He maintained that he could not affirm something that he had not observed and assured that his position was not related to the friendship or origin of the foreigner. “It's not because I get along well, nor because I'm from where he's from, but I can't say what I don't see,” he said. She added that, according to what she did observe, Parra was praying during that time. According to the complaint, the events that gave rise to the investigation occurred that morning and the acts reported were not consensual. The accusation indicates that one of the minors was the victim of a sexual assault and that the other was allegedly touched and kissed. Leiva reported that during the prayer he remained with his eyes closed and that at some moments he even turned on his back. "How am I going to see what's happening behind? Sometimes I looked like this on the wall," he explained. He also said that, according to what he later learned, the mother of one of the minors would have been the one who observed the situation and filed the complaint. The pastor also described the context of the prayers made by Parra in the community. According to his story, the Argentine went to different homes to pray and anoint houses, while some people sought his spiritual help. He said that on one of those occasions there was talk of a woman who supposedly had a “spell” in her stomach. Regarding the permanence of the evangelical pastor Parra in the community, Leiva indicated that he had been staying there for 16 days when the reported events occurred. He assured that during that period he observed him with behavior that he described as appropriate. “Well behaved, look, he was even there praying, just talking about God,” he said. The woman said that she provided him with food, although the pastor did not usually eat tortillas. As he explained, Parra bought flour and ground meat to prepare hamburgers and also cooked eggs. “If I have something and I'm eating, and you're on time, I have to give it to you,” she said, explaining why she fed him. Leiva reported that Parra initially stayed one or two nights in one space of the house and later stayed in another place, where he slept on the floor on a mattress. The pastor stated that she even thought about setting up a separate space for him to stay, but he would have refused to stay inside her house. According to Leiva, Parra told her that he did not want to make her uncomfortable or disrespect her marriage and that is why he preferred to sleep somewhere else. The pastor added that she has single granddaughters and that she observed that the foreigner did not approach them when they were alone. “I was watching,” he said, explaining that he maintained that precaution. The pastor recalled that she had even warned Parra that if anyone made a complaint about her behavior, they would have to leave the place. “If they had complained to me, I would tell them: 'Look, brother Alberto, it's going to go away,'” he said. He added that during the 16 days he was in the community no one had made a complaint to him. Leiva also said that Parra came to the community to look for her because he knew that she held cults. As she explained, the Argentine told her that he wanted to accompany her to preach and that she needed religious “covering.” She responded that they should meet him first, since he was not originally from the area. The pastor assured that her husband also agreed to support him and that, during his stay, Parra talked mainly about religious topics. “The whole time he was here, he only talked about God,” he said. He said that when a woman was alone, he did not approach her and that religious conversations were held with other people present. Leiva also reported that Parra claimed to have crossed 12 countries to reach Honduras and that he had traveled without money. The woman claimed that she observed him praying for different people and that, according to what she witnessed, he went to homes to pray. Regarding the current allegations, he maintained that the investigation will determine what happened. “If they find evidence that he raped, then he goes to prison,” said the pastor, who added: “Machines do not lie,” in reference to the examinations and tests that may be performed. He also insisted that he has no responsibility for the events and said that he remains in the community because he does not consider he has any reason to flee. The pastor explained that currently her congregation's services are held four times a week: Saturday, Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday. People begin to gather around 6:00 in the afternoon and the service begins at 7:00 and ends between 8:00 and 9:00 at night. He also pointed out that in the center of the community there are two other churches and that the temple where they congregate is still under construction, with about ten days of work, so they plan to place a support beam around the structure.

data.title: ¿Sol o lluvia? Así se comportará el clima en San Pedro Sula este fin de semana
data.description: San Pedro Sula, Honduras. Los habitantes deberán mantenerse atentos a las condiciones climáticas durante los próximos días, debido a que se pronostican lluvias, chubascos y tormentas eléctricas principalmente durante las tardes y noches. En los últimos días, el clima en la zona norte ha presentado variaciones, con jornadas soleadas durante las primeras horas y precipitaciones acompañadas de actividad eléctrica durante la noche. Este comportamiento continuará durante los próximos días, según el monitoreo de las autoridades. Alberto López, meteorólogo de la Secretaría de Gestión de Riesgos y Contingencias Nacionales (Copeco) en la región norte , explicó que las condiciones serán relativamente estables durante las primeras horas del día, pero aumentará la posibilidad de lluvias conforme avance la jornada. “En la zona norte vamos a tener lluvia viernes por la tarde, mañana sábado, domingo, lunes, martes. Estamos hablando de cinco días de lluvia por las tardes y las noches”, informó el meteorólogo. López aclaró que no se trata de lluvias permanentes durante las 24 horas, sino de precipitaciones que se concentrarán principalmente en horas de la tarde y la noche y que estarán acompañadas, en algunos sectores, por actividad eléctrica. “Siempre estaría en horas de la tarde y en horas de la noche y con la caracterización de tormentas eléctricas”, explicó. El meteorólogo señaló además que el cierre de la canícula favorecerá un incremento en la frecuencia de las lluvias en diferentes regiones del país. De acuerdo con el análisis de Copeco, las precipitaciones también comenzarán a beneficiar sectores del denominado corredor seco. “Ya estamos teniendo la finalización de la canícula y las lluvias van a ser un poco más frecuentes”, manifestó López. Para la zona norte, las autoridades mantienen especial atención debido a que las tormentas podrían estar acompañadas de vientos acelerados y racheados. Estos fenómenos ya han provocado reportes de caída de árboles y levantamiento de techos en diferentes sectores. “Mucho ojo a los vientos acelerados, a los vientos rachados que hemos tenido, caída de árboles y reportes de levantamiento de techos”, advirtió el meteorólogo. López también explicó que existe vigilancia ante la posible formación de un sistema de baja presión frente a las costas de Islas de la Bahía. De concretarse, este fenómeno podría favorecer la presencia de lluvias más importantes y generar algunas afectaciones. “No descartamos. Recuerde que estamos en una vigilancia. Se puede formar un sistema de baja presión para los próximos días frente a las costas de Islas de la Bahía y ese sistema de baja presión nos podría dejar chubascos importantes, lluvias y algún tipo de afectaciones”, señaló. Las condiciones previstas coinciden con el comportamiento meteorológico reportado recientemente en el noroccidente del país, donde Cortés, Santa Bárbara, Atlántida, Colón y el norte de Yoro han registrado precipitaciones con frecuencia durante las últimas semanas. Ante este panorama, las autoridades recomiendan a la población mantenerse pendiente de los avisos oficiales, especialmente quienes viven en sectores vulnerables a inundaciones, deslizamientos o crecidas de ríos y quebradas. “Mensaje a la población: estar pendientes, prevenidos en las zonas donde se presenta mayor vulnerabilidad y riesgos de inundaciones y donde ya se han presentado situaciones”, recomendó López. Para San Pedro Sula, el llamado también incluye tomar precauciones durante las tormentas eléctricas, asegurar techos y objetos que puedan ser desplazados por el viento y evitar permanecer en espacios abiertos cuando se registren descargas eléctricas. Copeco ha advertido además que el incremento de las lluvias puede generar condiciones adversas en distintos puntos del territorio, por lo que la población debe mantenerse informada ante cualquier actualización de las autoridades.
data.translatedTitle: Sun or rain? This is how the weather will behave in San Pedro Sula this weekend
data.translatedDescription: San Pedro Sula, Honduras. Residents should remain attentive to weather conditions over the next few days, as rain, showers and thunderstorms are forecast mainly during the afternoons and nights. In recent days, the weather in the northern area has shown variations, with sunny days during the first hours and precipitation accompanied by electrical activity during the night. This behavior will continue over the next few days, according to monitoring by the authorities. Alberto López, meteorologist at the National Risk and Contingency Management Secretariat (Copeco) in the northern region, explained that conditions will be relatively stable during the first hours of the day, but the possibility of rain will increase as the day progresses. "In the northern area we are going to have rain Friday afternoon, tomorrow Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Tuesday. We are talking about five days of rain in the afternoons and nights," reported the meteorologist. López clarified that these are not permanent rains for 24 hours, but rather precipitation that will be concentrated mainly in the afternoon and evening hours and that will be accompanied, in some sectors, by electrical activity. “It would always be in the afternoon and at night and with the characterization of electrical storms,” he explained. The meteorologist also pointed out that the closure of the dog days will favor an increase in the frequency of rain in different regions of the country. According to Copeco's analysis, rainfall will also begin to benefit sectors of the so-called dry corridor. “We are already having the end of the dog days and the rains are going to be a little more frequent,” said López. For the northern area, authorities are paying special attention because the storms could be accompanied by accelerated and gusty winds. These phenomena have already caused reports of falling trees and lifting roofs in different sectors. “Be very careful of the accelerated winds, the gusty winds we have had, falling trees and reports of roofs lifting,” the meteorologist warned. López also explained that there is surveillance for the possible formation of a low pressure system off the coast of the Bay Islands. If it materializes, this phenomenon could favor the presence of more significant rains and generate some effects. "We are not ruling it out. Remember that we are on a watch. A low pressure system could form for the next few days off the coast of the Bay Islands and that low pressure system could leave us with significant showers, rain and some type of damage," he said. The forecast conditions coincide with the meteorological behavior recently reported in the northwest of the country, where Cortés, Santa Bárbara, Atlántida, Colón and the north of Yoro have recorded frequent rainfall in recent weeks. Given this scenario, the authorities recommend that the population remain aware of official warnings, especially those who live in sectors vulnerable to floods, landslides or flooding of rivers and streams. “Message to the population: be alert, be warned in areas where there is greater vulnerability and risk of flooding and where situations have already arisen,” López recommended. For San Pedro Sula, the call also includes taking precautions during electrical storms, securing roofs and objects that can be moved by the wind and avoiding remaining in open spaces when electrical discharges are recorded. Copeco has also warned that the increase in rain can generate adverse conditions in different parts of the territory, so the population must stay informed of any update from the authorities.

data.title: Mente Sana lanza su tercera edición enfocada en cuatro retos de la salud mental
data.description: San Pedro Sula, Cortés. Hay conversaciones que pueden cambiar el futuro de un niño. Bajo esa premisa, Diario LA PRENSA celebró este viernes 18 de septiembre el tercer año del proyecto Mente Sana . Mente Sana es una iniciativa que nació para promover el bienestar emocional de la niñez y juventud hondureña y que, después de dos ediciones, amplía su alcance para involucrar también a padres de familia y a la audiencia en general. El lanzamiento de la tercera edición de Mente Sana 2026 se realizó en la Universidad Tecnológica de Honduras ( UTH ), aliado estratégico del proyecto durante estos tres años, con la participación de representantes del sector educativo y profesionales de la psicología. La iniciativa es impulsada por Diario LA PRENSA junto al Colegio de Psicólogos de Honduras (Copsih) y tiene como propósito educar, romper estigmas y brindar herramientas que permitan reconocer y atender situaciones relacionadas con la salud mental. Según datos de Unicef citados por el proyecto, siete de cada diez adolescentes viven con un trastorno de salud mental diagnosticado. Ante este escenario, Mente Sana mantiene vigente su mensaje: “Hay conversaciones que pueden cambiar el futuro de un niño”. La nueva etapa del proyecto comenzará el próximo lunes 21 de septiembre, cuando Mente Sana vuelva a las aulas para visitar los Centros de Educación Básica Hogar San José, Soledad Fernández, Dionisio de Herrera y Lila Luz de Maradiaga. En estos centros comenzará el abordaje de los temas mediante fascículos con historietas adaptadas a la realidad nacional y el acompañamiento de profesionales de la psicología. El primer fascículo de esta tercera edición estará dedicado al trastorno por déficit de atención e hiperactividad (TDAH) y estará disponible en las plataformas de Diario LA PRENSA hasta el 19 de octubre. De esta manera, Mente Sana busca que el aprendizaje no se quede únicamente en las aulas. La intención es acercarse también a las familias y a la audiencia , mediante contenidos y herramientas digitales que ayuden a identificar, entender y atender situaciones relacionadas con la salud mental. Al frente de esta nueva edición se encuentra el equipo de profesionales de Diario LA PRENSA y Grupo OPSA, dirigido este año por Tania Corona , jefa de Redacción. Durante el lanzamiento estuvieron presentes el máster Josías Guzmán, director de la carrera de Psicología de UTH; el licenciado Rafael Eduardo Rodríguez, director Departamental de Educación de Cortés; el licenciado Rafael Mejía Perdomo, del Colegio de Psicólogos en el departamento de Cortés; la máster en Psicología Clínica Claudia Avilés; y el doctor Edgardo Iraheta, nuevo director del Hospital Mario Catarino Rivas , además de destacados periodistas y profesionales de la Salud. La Universidad Tecnológica de Honduras (UTH) ha acompañado el proyecto como patrocinador y aliado estratégico durante sus tres años de trayectoria. A esta iniciativa también se suman Fundación Diunsa, World Vision, Camas Royal Excel, Cámara de Comercio e Industrias de Cortés (CCIC), El Colonial, Metrocinemas y Wow Media. Durante los dos primeros años, Mente Sana enfocó buena parte de sus esfuerzos en la capacitación de docentes mediante talleres, fascículos y contenidos difundidos a través de las plataformas de Diario LA PRENSA. El primer año permitió poner en marcha la iniciativa y recoger las primeras experiencias. El segundo sirvió para fortalecer la estrategia y comprender con mayor claridad algunas de las necesidades que enfrentan estudiantes y docentes. Ahora, en su tercera edición, el proyecto busca dar un paso más: llegar a las familias y a la audiencia en general, además de continuar acompañando a las comunidades educativas. Este año, los contenidos estarán centrados en cuatro temas: trastorno por déficit de atención e hiperactividad (TDAH), ansiedad, depresión y adicción a pantallas y redes sociales. Josías Guzmán, director nacional de la carrera de Psicología de UTH, explicó que la selección de estos temas responde a las experiencias recogidas durante las primeras ediciones y a situaciones que han podido observar en los centros educativos. Uno de los principales objetivos de Mente Sana es brindar información que permita distinguir entre comportamientos propios de cada etapa del desarrollo y situaciones que podrían requerir una valoración profesional.
data.translatedTitle: Mente Sana launches its third edition focused on four mental health challenges
data.translatedDescription: San Pedro Sula, Cortés. There are conversations that can change a child's future. Under that premise, Diario LA PRENSA celebrated this Friday, September 18, the third year of the Mente Sana project. Mente Sana is an initiative that was born to promote the emotional well-being of Honduran children and youth and that, after two editions, expands its reach to also involve parents and the general audience. The launch of the third edition of Mente Sana 2026 was held at the Technological University of Honduras (UTH), a strategic ally of the project during these three years, with the participation of representatives of the educational sector and psychology professionals. The initiative is promoted by Diario LA PRENSA together with the College of Psychologists of Honduras (Copsih) and its purpose is to educate, break stigmas and provide tools that allow recognizing and addressing situations related to mental health. According to Unicef ​​data cited by the project, seven out of ten adolescents live with a diagnosed mental health disorder. Faced with this scenario, Mente Sana maintains its message: “There are conversations that can change a child's future.” The new stage of the project will begin next Monday, September 21, when Mente Sana returns to the classrooms to visit the Hogar San José, Soledad Fernández, Dionisio de Herrera and Lila Luz de Maradiaga Basic Education Centers. In these centers, the topics will begin to be addressed through fascicles with comics adapted to the national reality and the support of psychology professionals. The first issue of this third edition will be dedicated to attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and will be available on the Diario LA PRENSA platforms until October 19. In this way, Mente Sana seeks that learning does not remain only in the classrooms. The intention is to also get closer to families and the audience, through content and digital tools that help identify, understand and address situations related to mental health. At the helm of this new edition is the team of professionals from Diario LA PRENSA and Grupo OPSA, led this year by Tania Corona, Editor-in-Chief. Present during the launch were master Josías Guzmán, director of the Psychology degree at UTH; Mr. Rafael Eduardo Rodríguez, Departmental Director of Education of Cortés; Mr. Rafael Mejía Perdomo, from the College of Psychologists in the department of Cortés; the master's degree in Clinical Psychology Claudia Avilés; and Dr. Edgardo Iraheta, new director of the Mario Catarino Rivas Hospital, as well as prominent journalists and health professionals. The Technological University of Honduras (UTH) has accompanied the project as a sponsor and strategic ally during its three years of history. Fundación Diunsa, World Vision, Camas Royal Excel, Chamber of Commerce and Industries of Cortés (CCIC), El Colonial, Metrocinemas and Wow Media also join this initiative. During the first two years, Mente Sana focused much of its efforts on training teachers through workshops, fascicles and content disseminated through the Diario LA PRENSA platforms. The first year allowed us to launch the initiative and collect the first experiences. The second served to strengthen the strategy and understand more clearly some of the needs faced by students and teachers. Now, in its third edition, the project seeks to take another step: reach families and the general audience, in addition to continuing to accompany educational communities. This year, the content will focus on four topics: attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), anxiety, depression and addiction to screens and social networks. Josías Guzmán, national director of the Psychology program at UTH, explained that the selection of these topics responds to the experiences collected during the first editions and to situations that they have been able to observe in educational centers. One of the main objectives of Mente Sana is to provide information that allows us to distinguish between behaviors typical of each stage of development and situations that could require a professional assessment.

data.title: Autoridades mexicanas entregan el cuerpo de Claudia Tacoronte a su familia en Morelos
data.description: Cuernavaca, México. La Fiscalía del estado mexicano de Morelos (centro) entregó a su familia este viernes el cuerpo de la estudiante española Claudia Tacoronte , quien fue asesinada el pasado sábado en el municipio de Cuautla , un día después de que fuera detenido el presunto feminicida, conocido como El Trompas . Varios integrantes de la familia de la joven española de 21 años llegaron a las instalaciones de la Fiscalía estatal , ubicada en Temixco, a las afueras de Cuernavaca (capital del estado), y fueron acompañados del cónsul de España en México , Marcos Rodríguez, informaron a EFE fuentes de la Fiscalía estatal Asimismo, estuvieron presentes representantes de la Comisión Ejecutiva de Atención a Víctimas (CEAV) , así como el fiscal general de Morelos, Fernando Blumenkron Escobar, y el secretario de Gobierno, Edgar Maldonado. "Hemos realizado la entrega formal del cuerpo de Claudia a su papá, el señor Valentín (...) Explicamos cómo es el procedimiento, la identificación correspondiente", indicó Blumenkron a medios de comunicación. La entrega del cuerpo para su repatriación se realiza un día después de la detención de Francisco Javier, alias El Trompas, identificado como presunto responsable del feminicidio. El hombre fue capturado por las autoridades federales y estatales en Cuautla, lugar del crimen y ubicado a 120 kilómetros al sur de Ciudad de México. El Trompas fue trasladado e ingresado la noche del jueves al Centro Estatal de Reinserción Social (Cereso) de Cuautla, donde permanece a disposición de la autoridad judicial. Las Fiscalía de Morelos anunció que imputará al sospechoso por el delito de feminicidio y buscará una pena máxima de setenta años de prisión. Tacoronte, una mujer canaria de 21 años había llegado a México a mediados de agosto para realizar un intercambio académico entre la Universidad de Granada y la Universidad Autónoma del Estado de Morelos (UAEM). El asesinato ha provocado indignación dentro y fuera de México después de conocerse que Tacoronte es la cuarta alumna de la UAEM asesinada en apenas siete meses, tras los casos de Kimberly Ramos, Karol Toledo y Michelle Itzayana Fuentes, que ya habían generado protestas y paros estudiantiles.
data.translatedTitle: Mexican authorities deliver the body of Claudia Tacoronte to her family in Morelos
data.translatedDescription: Cuernavaca, Mexico. The Prosecutor's Office of the Mexican state of Morelos (center) handed over to her family this Friday the body of the Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte, who was murdered last Saturday in the municipality of Cuautla, one day after the alleged feminicide, known as El Trompas, was arrested. Several members of the family of the 21-year-old Spanish girl arrived at the facilities of the State Prosecutor's Office, located in Temixco, on the outskirts of Cuernavaca (state capital), and were accompanied by the Spanish consul in Mexico, Marcos Rodríguez, sources from the State Prosecutor's Office informed EFE. Likewise, representatives of the Executive Commission for Attention to Victims (CEAV) were present, as well as the Attorney General of Morelos, Fernando Blumenkron Escobar, and the Secretary of Government, Edgar Maldonado. "We have formally handed over Claudia's body to her father, Mr. Valentín (...) We explained what the procedure is like, the corresponding identification," Blumenkron told the media. The delivery of the body for repatriation takes place one day after the arrest of Francisco Javier, alias El Trompas, identified as the alleged perpetrator of the feminicide. The man was captured by federal and state authorities in Cuautla, the scene of the crime and located 120 kilometers south of Mexico City. Trompas was transferred and admitted on Thursday night to the State Center for Social Reintegration (Cereso) of Cuautla, where he remains at the disposal of the judicial authority. The Morelos Prosecutor's Office announced that it will charge the suspect with the crime of femicide and will seek a maximum sentence of seventy years in prison. Tacoronte, a 21-year-old Canarian woman, had arrived in Mexico in mid-August to carry out an academic exchange between the University of Granada and the Autonomous University of the State of Morelos (UAEM). The murder has caused outrage inside and outside Mexico after it was learned that Tacoronte is the fourth UAEM student murdered in just seven months, after the cases of Kimberly Ramos, Karol Toledo and Michelle Itzayana Fuentes, which had already generated protests and student strikes.
