data.title: Menjívar responde: "Fui un espectador más. Aquí están los muchachos del establo"
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras .- El guardameta de Olimpia, Edrick Menjívar , se pronunció con contundencia tras la clasificación del conjunto albo a las semifinales de la Copa Centroamericana . Luego de superar al Firpo de El Salvador con un global de 6-0, el portero hondureño respondió a los señalamientos de los rivales y a las críticas de sectores de la prensa salvadoreña. Menjívar no ocultó que las declaraciones del rival después del primer encuentro sirvieron de motivación para el vestuario merengue. "Teníamos una molestia interna por todo lo que se había hablado. Creo que tanto al entrenador de ellos como a su jugador les hizo falta bastante humildad. Tienen que lavarse la boca cuando hablan del Olimpia ", afirmó. El arquero cuestionó las opiniones que aseguraban que Firpo había superado a Olimpia en la ida: "Salieron diciendo que nos habían pasado por encima por 45 minutos buenos que tuvieron. Hay que recordarles que las series son de 180 minutos, no de 45". Además, Edrick Menjívar detalló la escasa presencia ofensiva del cuadro salvadoreño en la eliminatoria: "Patearon dos veces al marco en el primer tiempo allá y con eso se conformaron, porque no volvieron a tirar a gol". En cuanto al partido de vuelta, donde Olimpia dominó de principio a fin, el guardameta comentó: "Hoy fui un espectador más. A ver qué sale a decir su entrenador ahora". Menjívar también salió al paso de los comentarios contra las instalaciones del Centro de Alto Rendimiento ( CAR ) del club blanco: "La prensa salvadoreña habló cosas fuera de lugar. Dijeron que el CAR parecía un establo. Los invito a que vengan y lo visiten, para que conozcan lo que realmente es un Centro de Alto Rendimiento y una cancha de calidad". "Aquí están los muchachos del establo. Fue una bronca interna, nosotros ganamos 3-0 y en ningún momento hablamos de ellos, les hicimos tres goles y salen a hablar del Olimpia ". A su vez, remarcó la trayectoria y el jerarquía del conjunto hondureño en la región: "A Olimpia , el equipo más grande de Centroamérica, y al fútbol hondureño no se les puede faltar al respeto. Les faltó humildad y todo eso terminó siendo gasolina para nosotros. Vimos las declaraciones tras el partido de ida y no nos gustaron para nada". A pesar de sus críticas, reconoció la calidad futbolística del rival: "Respetamos a todos los equipos. Firpo es un gran club y juega muy bien, pero considero que a su técnico le faltó humildad". Con la mirada puesta en la siguiente fase, Menjívar rechazó dar por asegurado el título de la Copa Centroamericana: "Estamos cerca, pero al igual que los cuatro equipos que estamos en semifinales. Decir que vamos a ser campeones sería una falta de respeto para los otros tres clubes". El guardameta concluyó reafirmando la mentalidad de Olimpia para afrontar el cierre del torneo: "Primero hay que pensar en la semifinal, que será una llave muy difícil. Nosotros vamos partido a partido, tanto en la Liga como en la Copa, y ese ha sido nuestro éxito".
data.translatedTitle: Menjívar responds: "I was just another spectator. Here are the boys from the stable"
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Olimpia's goalkeeper, Edrick Menjívar, spoke forcefully after the white team's classification to the semifinals of the Central American Cup. After beating Firpo of El Salvador with a 6-0 aggregate score, the Honduran goalkeeper responded to the accusations of rivals and criticism from sectors of the Salvadoran press. Menjívar did not hide that the rival's statements after the first match served as motivation for the merengue locker room. "We had an internal annoyance because of everything that had been talked about. I think both their coach and his player needed a lot of humility. They have to wash their mouths when they talk about Olimpia," he stated. The goalkeeper questioned the opinions that claimed that Firpo had surpassed Olimpia in the first leg: "They came out saying that they had surpassed us for 45 good minutes that they had. We must remind them that the series are 180 minutes, not 45." Furthermore, Edrick Menjívar detailed the lack of offensive presence of the Salvadoran team in the tie: "They kicked the goal twice in the first half there and they settled for that, because they didn't shoot on goal again." Regarding the second leg, where Olimpia dominated from start to finish, the goalkeeper commented: "Today I was just another spectator. Let's see what their coach comes out to say now." Menjívar also addressed the comments against the facilities of the White Club's High Performance Center (CAR): "The Salvadoran press spoke things that were out of place. They said that the CAR looked like a stable. I invite you to come and visit it, so that you can see what a High Performance Center and a quality field really is." "Here are the boys from the stable. It was an internal fight, we won 3-0 and at no time did we talk about them, we scored three goals against them and they come out to talk about Olimpia." At the same time, he highlighted the trajectory and hierarchy of the Honduran team in the region: "Olimpia, the biggest team in Central America, and Honduran soccer cannot be disrespected. They lacked humility and all that ended up being gasoline for us. We saw the statements after the first leg and we didn't like them at all." Despite his criticism, he recognized the rival's football quality: "We respect all the teams. Firpo is a great club and plays very well, but I think that its coach lacked humility." With his sights set on the next phase, Menjívar refused to take the Central American Cup title for granted: "We are close, but like the four teams we are in the semifinals. Saying that we are going to be champions would be a lack of respect for the other three clubs." The goalkeeper concluded by reaffirming Olimpia's mentality to face the end of the tournament: "First we have to think about the semifinal, which will be a very difficult key. We go game by game, both in the League and in the Cup, and that has been our success."

data.title: Acusan a hondureño de asesinar a cuatro miembros de una familia en Texas, EE UU
data.description: Texas, Estados Unidos.- En el estado de Texas en Estados Unidos , un hondureño es acusado de haber asesinado a disparos a cuatro integrantes de una familia mexicana. El imputado es Christian Joel Maldonado Pacheco, quien fue capturado el 13 de septiembre en las afueras de la ciudad de San Benito. El sheriff del condado de Cameron, Manuel Treviño, explicó que alrededor de las 3 de la madrugadad de ese día Pacheco llamó al 911 para reportar que él mismo había matado a un par de personas. Los agentes llegaron a la cuadra 3200 de la carretera 819 y detuvieron al hondureño sin inconvenientes. Además, fuera de la residencia encontraron una pistola Glock de nueve mílimetros, sospechosa de haber sido utilizada por Pacheco. "Inmediatamente, los agentes entraron en la casa para ver si podían prestar ayuda alguna de las víctimas que se encontraban allí, pero lamentablemente, las tres víctimas que estaban dentro de la casa ya habían fallecido", detalló el sheriff. Asimismo, señaló que cuando Pacheco fue interrogado, confesó que no solo había matado a estas tres personas, sino también "haber cometido otro asesinato esa misma noche y haber arrojado el cuerpo en las afueras de Benito". Las víctimas fueron dos hombres de 50 y 29 años, así como dos mujeres de 28 y 67 años. Sobre esta última, Pacheco se dirigía a ella como "mamá". De acuerdo a los informes policiales, Pacheco Maldonado no compartía vínculos familiares con estas personas, pero sí vivió con ellas durante cuatro años. El hombre de 29 años y la mujer de 28 eran pareja y padres de dos menores de nueve y cinco años, así como de un bebé de dos meses. Treviño indicó que estos menores fueron hallados dentro de la vivienda, pero que resultaron ilesos en el ataque armado. Treviño indicó que Pacheco afirmó que tomó esta decisión porque "estaba cansado de ser acosado. No hay nada que corrobore esa declaración. Aclaremos que no hay nada. Esta es solo su opinión de que lo hizo porque estaba cansado de ser acosado". "Para mí, fue un acto sin sentido cometido por alguien a quien considero una persona fría y despiadada (...) porque cuando vives con estas personas durante cuatro años, y a una de ellas la identificas como 'mamá, pero aun así la matas. Así que no, no diría que esto es lo normal. Para mí, es una persona sin remordimientos, un asesino a sangre fría", dijo el sheriff. El Servicio de de Control de Inmigración y Aduanas (ICE, por sus siglas en inglés) determinó que Pacheco ingresó al país de forma irregular y emitió una orden de captura en su contra. Pacheco compareció ante el Tribunal del Distrito de Texas y se le imputa por cuatro cargos de asesinato capital, tres cargos de abandono y puesta en peligro de un menor de edad.
data.translatedTitle: Honduran man accused of murdering four members of a family in Texas, USA
data.translatedDescription: Texas, United States.- In the state of Texas in the United States, a Honduran man is accused of having shot and killed four members of a Mexican family. The accused is Christian Joel Maldonado Pacheco, who was captured on September 13 on the outskirts of the city of San Benito. Cameron County Sheriff Manuel Treviño explained that around 3 a.m. that day Pacheco called 911 to report that he himself had killed a couple of people. The agents arrived at the 3200 block of Highway 819 and detained the Honduran without any problems. Additionally, outside the residence they found a nine-millimeter Glock pistol, suspected of having been used by Pacheco. "Immediately, officers entered the house to see if they could help any of the victims who were there, but unfortunately, the three victims who were inside the house had already died," the sheriff explained. Likewise, he noted that when Pacheco was interrogated, he confessed that he had not only killed these three people, but also "having committed another murder that same night and having dumped the body on the outskirts of Benito." The victims were two men aged 50 and 29, as well as two women aged 28 and 67. Regarding the latter, Pacheco addressed her as "mom." According to police reports, Pacheco Maldonado did not share family ties with these people, but he did live with them for four years. The 29-year-old man and the 28-year-old woman were a couple and parents of two children aged nine and five, as well as a two-month-old baby. Treviño indicated that these minors were found inside the home, but that they were unharmed in the armed attack. Treviño indicated that Pacheco stated that he made this decision because "he was tired of being harassed. There is nothing to corroborate that statement. Let's clarify that there is nothing. This is just his opinion that he did it because he was tired of being harassed." "To me, it was a senseless act committed by someone who I consider to be a cold and ruthless person (...) because when you live with these people for four years, and you identify one of them as 'Mom, but you still kill her. So no, I wouldn't say this is normal. To me, this is a person without remorse, a cold-blooded killer," the sheriff said. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) determined that Pacheco entered the country irregularly and issued an arrest warrant against him. Pacheco appeared in Texas District Court and is charged with four counts of capital murder, three counts of abandonment and endangerment of a minor.

data.title: Expareja de Fernando Cerimedo declara en su contra por enriquecimiento ilícito
data.description: La Paz, Bolivia.- La abogada y operadora política Nadia Beller, expareja del consultor político argentino Fernando Cerimedo , el pasado jueves ante la Fiscalía de Bolivia en el caso de supuesto enriquecimiento ilícito por el que el estratega cumple detención preventiva en un penal en el altiplano del país. Beller se presentó ante las autoridades, en la ciudad oriental de Santa Cruz, en medio de un operativo con fuertes medidas de seguridad para ofrecer una declaración que duró alrededor de tres horas y tras la cual se retiró sin hablar a la prensa. Su abogado, Jerjes Justiniano, dijo a los medios que Beller declaró "en calidad de testigo" y que la Fiscalía formuló alrededor de un centenar de preguntas que "todas" fueron respondidas por su defendida. Justiniano también mencionó que los abogados de Cerimedo plantearon un "contrainterrogatorio", por lo que el testimonio de Beller "ya es una prueba" en este proceso judicial. Horas antes de su declaración ante el Ministerio Público, Beller publicó un mensaje en sus redes sociales en el que mencionó que esta jornada se cumple un mes del ataque armado que sufrió y por el que Cerimedo fue inicialmente detenido, acusado de feminicidio en grado de tentativa. En su mensaje, la mujer reafirmó que Cerimedo intentó silenciarla "para evitar que hablara y denunciara" presuntos hechos de corrupción y manejos irregulares de "asuntos públicos". También denunció ser blanco de una "revictimización comunicacional" y que tras sobrevivir al ataque intentaron convertirla en "culpable". "Por eso sigo hablando. No por venganza. No para construir una historia, sino para buscar justicia. Hablo porque sobreviví y porque tengo el deber de contar lo que sé para desenmascarar a estos corruptos", añadió. El viernes, Cerimedo afrontará una audiencia virtual que se realizará en Santa Cruz, por el caso de intento de feminicidio contra Beller, en el que la Fiscalía solicitará la "incautación de la información digital" del teléfono y la computadora de Cerimedo, dijo la defensa de Beller. Cerimedo está detenido en Bolivia desde el 18 de agosto y enfrenta una investigación por intento de feminicidio contra Beller y una causa por violencia de género por hechos del mes de julio. Por el caso de presunto enriquecimiento ilícito, Cerimedo fue trasladado de un penal de Santa Cruz a otro en La Paz. Los procesos contra Cerimedo han puesto bajo la lupa la relación que tuvo con el presidente boliviano, Rodrigo Paz, después de que sus detractores, entre ellos el expresidente Evo Morales (2006-2019) y el vicepresidente Edmand Lara, afirmaran que fue asesor personal del mandatario. Cerimedo admitió que es amigo de Paz, pero sostuvo que su colaboración fue informal, que nunca tuvo un contrato ni fue funcionario del Estado y negó haber influido en el Gobierno. El argentino formó parte de la estrategia de comunicación del actual presidente argentino, Javier Milei, durante la campaña presidencial de 2023 y fundó en 2021 el portal La Derecha Diario.
data.translatedTitle: Fernando Cerimedo's ex-partner testifies against him for illicit enrichment
data.translatedDescription: La Paz, Bolivia.- The lawyer and political operator Nadia Beller, ex-partner of the Argentine political consultant Fernando Cerimedo, last Thursday before the Bolivian Prosecutor's Office in the case of alleged illicit enrichment for which the strategist is serving preventive detention in a prison in the country's highlands. Beller appeared before the authorities, in the eastern city of Santa Cruz, in the middle of an operation with strong security measures to offer a statement that lasted around three hours and after which he left without speaking to the press. His lawyer, Jerjes Justiniano, told the media that Beller testified "as a witness" and that the Prosecutor's Office asked around a hundred questions that "all" were answered by his client. Justiniano also mentioned that Cerimedo's lawyers raised a "cross-examination", so Beller's testimony "is already evidence" in this judicial process. Hours before his statement before the Public Ministry, Beller published a message on his social networks in which he mentioned that this day marks one month since the armed attack he suffered and for which Cerimedo was initially arrested, accused of attempted femicide. In her message, the woman reaffirmed that Cerimedo tried to silence her "to prevent her from speaking and reporting" alleged acts of corruption and irregular handling of "public affairs." She also reported being the target of "communicational revictimization" and that after surviving the attack they tried to make her "guilty." "That's why I continue speaking. Not for revenge. Not to build a story, but to seek justice. I speak because I survived and because I have the duty to tell what I know to unmask these corrupt people," he added. On Friday, Cerimedo will face a virtual hearing to be held in Santa Cruz, for the case of attempted femicide against Beller, in which the Prosecutor's Office will request the "seizure of digital information" from Cerimedo's phone and computer, Beller's defense said. Cerimedo has been detained in Bolivia since August 18 and faces an investigation for attempted feminicide against Beller and a case for gender violence for events in the month of July. Due to the case of alleged illicit enrichment, Cerimedo was transferred from a prison in Santa Cruz to another in La Paz. The processes against Cerimedo have put the relationship he had with the Bolivian president, Rodrigo Paz, under the microscope, after his detractors, including former president Evo Morales (2006-2019) and vice president Edmand Lara, affirmed that he was the president's personal advisor. Cerimedo admitted that he is a friend of Paz, but maintained that his collaboration was informal, that he never had a contract nor was he a State official and denied having influenced the Government. The Argentine was part of the communication strategy of the current Argentine president, Javier Milei, during the 2023 presidential campaign and founded the La Derecha Diario portal in 2021.

data.title: Hallan muerto a reconocido maestro en la orilla del río Wampú en Olancho
data.description: Olancho, Honduras.- El reciente jueves 17 de septiembre, un hombre fue encontrado muerto en la orilla del río Wampú , situado en el municipio de Dulce Nombre de Culmí, en el departamento de Olancho . De acuerdo con el reporte preliminar de las autoridades, la víctima fue identificada como José Ángel Macías , quien era un reconocido docente que laboraba en la comunidad de La Bellota. Medios locales informaron que el docente tenía signos de violencia en el cuerpo, sin embargo, la muerte se categorizó como indeterminada en primera instancia, ya que serán las autoridades forenses quienes determinen la causa. Al lugar llegaron agentes de la Policía Nacional para acordonar la escena y realizar las respectivas indagaciones. Asimismo, arribaron miembros de Medicina Forense para realizar el levantamiento y traslado del cadáver hacia la morgue para efectos de autopsia. La noticia sobre la muerte del docente ha generado profunda consternación entres familiares, amigos, estudiantes y compañeros de trabajo y vecinos, especialmente porque ocurrió en pleno Día del Maestro . Muchos lo recuerdan como un maestro dedicado y cariñoso con sus estudiantes. Allegados al docente señalaron que su última aparición pública tuvo lugar durante los desfiles del 15 de septiembre, donde compartió con la comunidad. Usuarios dejaron plasmaron sus muestras de pesar a través de redes sociales, solidarizándose con la familia doliente. "Que en paz descanse, compañero José Ángel, y vaya mi pésame para la compañera Loyda". "Qué pesar, él estuvo con nosotros celebrando el 15 de septiembre en nuestra comunidad, con la red de la zona", son algunos de los comentarios que se leen tras la noticia. Los familiares y demás seres queridos del docente se encuentran consternados, pero esperan que las autoridades investiguen cuál fue la causa de muerte. Mientras tanto, la comunidad se prepara para darle el último adiós al apreciado docente en un cementerio local, en la tierra que lo vio nacer.
data.translatedTitle: A renowned teacher is found dead on the shore of the Wampú River in Olancho
data.translatedDescription: Olancho, Honduras.- On recent Thursday, September 17, a man was found dead on the bank of the Wampú River, located in the municipality of Dulce Nombre de Culmí, in the department of Olancho. According to the preliminary report from the authorities, the victim was identified as José Ángel Macías, who was a renowned teacher who worked in the community of La Bellota. Local media reported that the teacher had signs of violence on his body, however, the death was categorized as undetermined in the first instance, since the forensic authorities will be the ones to determine the cause. Agents from the National Police arrived at the scene to cordon off the scene and carry out the respective investigations. Likewise, members of Forensic Medicine arrived to lift and transfer the body to the morgue for autopsy purposes. The news about the teacher's death has generated deep consternation among family, friends, students and co-workers and neighbors, especially because it occurred in the middle of Teacher's Day. Many remember him as a dedicated and caring teacher with his students. Those close to the teacher indicated that his last public appearance took place during the parades on September 15, where he shared with the community. Users expressed their expressions of regret through social networks, expressing solidarity with the grieving family. "May he rest in peace, comrade José Ángel, and my condolences go to comrade Loyda." "What a shame, he was with us celebrating September 15 in our community, with the area network," are some of the comments read after the news. The teacher's family and other loved ones are dismayed, but they hope that the authorities will investigate the cause of death. Meanwhile, the community is preparing to say goodbye to the appreciated teacher in a local cemetery, in the land where he was born.

data.title: Estimulación de lluvias: SAG contempla 20 vuelos y 2,000 litros de yoduro de plata
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La Secretaría de Agricultura y Ganadería (SAG) utilizará alrededor de 2,000 litros de yoduro de plata en 20 vuelos del proyecto de estimulación de lluvias, con los que se pretende abarcar cerca de dos millones de hectáreas afectadas por la sequía. El titular de la SAG, Moisés Molina, explicó que el volumen del compuesto será distribuido durante las operaciones aéreas, mientras se amplían las áreas que serán incorporadas al proyecto de estimulación de lluvias. “Se van a utilizar 2,000 litros para 20 vuelos en más o menos 2 millones de hectáreas. Saquen ustedes la posibilidad de que haya toxicidad relacionando esos volúmenes y esas áreas”, manifestó Molina. De acuerdo con la distribución planteada por la SAG, el promedio sería de unos 100 litros de yoduro de plata por vuelo, aunque la cantidad utilizada en cada operación dependerá de las condiciones y del área que se pretenda intervenir. Molina defendió la decisión de ejecutar el proyecto ante la emergencia provocada por la falta de agua y señaló que las autoridades también deberán medir posteriormente la relación entre los recursos utilizados y los beneficios obtenidos. “En cuanto al beneficio-costo es algo que vamos justamente a tratar de medir”, indicó el funcionario. Molina explicó que la intervención no sustituye las obras de infraestructura necesarias para garantizar agua para riego, pero sostuvo que esas alternativas requieren precisamente contar con suficiente recurso hídrico. “Para que haya sistemas de riego funcionales, tiene que haber agua. Y justamente el problema es el agua”, expresó funcionario, quien señaló que el gobierno también trabaja en infraestructura para retención y almacenamiento. La cobertura territorial todavía se encuentra en proceso de definición debido a que las autoridades continúan ampliando las áreas que serán incluidas en el programa, por lo que el alcance final podría modificarse. Inicialmente, la SAG concentra sus esfuerzos en el corredor seco , además de la zona del Alto del Aguán, que también enfrenta condiciones de sequía, y las cuencas que abastecen las represas que suministran agua a Tegucigalpa. “Esta es una situación de emergencia. Si alguien tuviese alguna idea distinta, que la proponga. Lo vamos a escuchar”, manifestó el titular de la SAG. Las autoridades dijeron que también sumarán zonas donde están los afluentes que abastecen la represa El Cajón, luego de que el presidente Nasry Asfura le solicitó incorporar esas áreas dentro del proyecto de estimulación de lluvias. La participación del sector privado también continúa en proceso, debido a que todavía se están recaudando los recursos que serán destinados al programa. Molina indicó que ya existe una cantidad importante reunida, pero no precisó el monto total. Por su parte, Alejandro Trueba, representante de la empresa mexicana Startup Renaissance interesada en el proyecto, señaló que no existe una garantía absoluta sobre la cantidad de lluvia que se podrá generar mediante el procedimiento. “Es una garantía muy relativa, muy complicada. Yo les podría decir que vamos a estar por arriba del 40% de lo que esperábamos llover, porque es lo menos que hemos logrado ya en los 35 proyectos previos”, afirmó Trueba. El representante de la empresa explicó que el proyecto será evaluado mediante dos parámetros: eficiencia y eficacia. El primero, según detalló, corresponde a las ocasiones en que las operaciones logran generar lluvia después de que el avión despega. “Eficiencia es cuando nosotros despegamos para buscar una estimulación de lluvias. De las 100 veces que salgamos, ¿cuántas tuvieron lluvia? 100%. Todas las veces que hemos salido, todas las veces que hemos generado lluvia”, sostuvo. El segundo parámetro corresponde al incremento de las precipitaciones obtenido durante las operaciones. Trueba aseguró que, con base en los proyectos anteriores de la empresa, el promedio de aumento registrado ha sido del 60%. “Y el segundo es eficacia. ¿Qué tan eficaz es? ¿Cuánto aumenta? Y eso es lo que hemos medido, en un promedio del 60%. Entonces, esto nos va a dar resultado”, aseguró el representante de Startup Renaissance. Para documentar los resultados, la empresa informó que utilizará imágenes satelitales, registros de los vuelos y sistemas de posicionamiento global (GPS), además de información procedente de estaciones pluviométricas. Trueba explicó que los registros permitirán conocer la trayectoria del avión y comparar las precipitaciones registradas con las lluvias que originalmente estaban previstas para cada zona intervenida.
data.translatedTitle: Rain stimulation: SAG contemplates 20 flights and 2,000 liters of silver iodide
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (SAG) will use around 2,000 liters of silver iodide in 20 flights of the rain stimulation project, which is intended to cover nearly two million hectares affected by drought. The head of the SAG, Moisés Molina, explained that the volume of the compound will be distributed during aerial operations, while the areas that will be incorporated into the rain stimulation project are expanded. "2,000 liters are going to be used for 20 flights in more or less 2 million hectares. Take out the possibility of toxicity by relating those volumes and those areas," said Molina. According to the distribution proposed by the SAG, the average would be about 100 liters of silver iodide per flight, although the amount used in each operation will depend on the conditions and the area to be intervened. Molina defended the decision to execute the project in the face of the emergency caused by the lack of water and pointed out that the authorities must also subsequently measure the relationship between the resources used and the benefits obtained. “As for the benefit-cost, it is something that we are precisely going to try to measure,” said the official. Molina explained that the intervention does not replace the infrastructure works necessary to guarantee water for irrigation, but maintained that these alternatives precisely require having sufficient water resources. "For there to be functional irrigation systems, there has to be water. And the problem is precisely water," said an official, who pointed out that the government is also working on infrastructure for retention and storage. The territorial coverage is still in the process of definition because the authorities continue to expand the areas that will be included in the program, so the final scope could be modified. Initially, the SAG focuses its efforts on the dry corridor, in addition to the Alto del Aguán area, which also faces drought conditions, and the basins that supply the dams that supply water to Tegucigalpa. "This is an emergency situation. If anyone has a different idea, please propose it. We will listen to it," said the head of the SAG. The authorities said that they will also add areas where the tributaries that supply the El Cajón dam are located, after President Nasry Asfura asked them to incorporate those areas into the rain stimulation project. The participation of the private sector also continues in the process, because the resources that will be allocated to the program are still being collected. Molina indicated that there is already a significant amount collected, but did not specify the total amount. For his part, Alejandro Trueba, representative of the Mexican company Startup Renaissance interested in the project, pointed out that there is no absolute guarantee on the amount of rain that can be generated through the procedure. "It is a very relative guarantee, very complicated. I could tell you that we are going to be above 40% of what we expected to rain, because it is the least we have already achieved in the 35 previous projects," said Trueba. The company representative explained that the project will be evaluated using two parameters: efficiency and effectiveness. The first, as detailed, corresponds to the occasions in which operations manage to generate rain after the plane takes off. "Efficiency is when we take off to look for rain stimulation. Of the 100 times we go out, how many had rain? 100%. All the times we have gone out, all the times we have generated rain," he said. The second parameter corresponds to the increase in precipitation obtained during operations. Trueba assured that, based on the company's previous projects, the average increase recorded has been 60%. "And the second is effectiveness. How effective is it? How much does it increase? And that is what we have measured, on an average of 60%. So, this is going to work for us," said the Startup Renaissance representative. To document the results, the company reported that it will use satellite images, flight records and global positioning systems (GPS), in addition to information from rainfall stations. Trueba explained that the records will allow us to know the trajectory of the plane and compare the recorded rainfall with the rain that was originally planned for each intervened area.

data.title: "No confíen en el MP": nuevo video de Dereck McNeil sobre el caso de Angie Peña
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Recientemente ha circulado un nuevo video que dejó grabado Dereck McNeil, testigo protegido en el caso de Angie Peña quien fue asesinado, en el cual alerta a cualquier persona que quiera testificar a no confiar en las autoridades del Ministerio Público (MP). Al inicio del material audiovisual, McNeil relató que fue llevado a una cafetería privada en San Pedro Sula para reunirse con el titular de la Agencia Técnica de Investigación Criminal (ATIC) y "uno de narcotráfico" (sin especificar si se trataba de un agente de la Dirección de Lucha Contra el Narcotráfico -DLCN- u otra entidad). "A ellos lo que les interesa es la información de narcotráfico para venderla. Ellos se queman entre ellos mismos. De ahí vienen ellos y hacen bajetes de droga porque aquel le ofrece información a cambio de protección, de dinero y todo eso", dijo McNeil. Describió que la ATIC estaba "muy corrupta" y que decidió documentar sus testimonios en videos, previendo el escenario de que estuviera muerto. "Yo les voy a decir una cosa: los testigos protegidos, no confíen más en el Ministerio Público. El Ministerio Público está lleno de corrupción y mientras esto siga así, eso no sirve. La fiscalía es una basura. Esos son falsas promesas", agregó, sugiriendo a los testigos protegidos tampoco confiar en la Dirección Policial de Investigaciones (DPI) ni de la ATIC, calificándolos como "mentirosos". Por el contrario, recomendó que mejor se aboquen a personas certificadas de la Embajada de Estados Unidos en Honduras "o mejor no hablen. Quédense callados porque si hablan, siempre los van a matar. En mi caso, a mí me han querido matar, me intimidaron". "Todas las personas, sépanlo. Yo fui una persona que quiso ayudar a una causa y más bien terminé siendo yo el delincuente de los delincuentes ¡Imagínense! Por favor, a todas las personas que vean este video, tengan mucho cuidado. Esto no es algo que es falso", aseveró. De igual forma, afirmó que iría "probando muchas cosas", acto que no pudo lograr al ser acribillado a disparos el 17 de agosto en Roatán, Islas de la Bahía. Concluyendo el video, McNeil aseguró que la ATIC defendía a narcotraficantes con órdenes de captura. Seguidamente, declaró que si se deseaba llegar al titular de la ATIC, había que dedicarse al tráfico de drogas. "Si los judicializan, es porque no llegaron al precio correcto, ¿verdad? Si no, papa, sigues dando droga y le das su porcentaje a ATIC", comentó. Después de la muerte de McNeil, se han difundido varios videos de él en el que denunciaba corrupción y cotubernio por parte de la ATIC en el caso de Angie Peña, joven que permanece desaparecida desde enero de 2022. Sin embargo, la ATIC ha sostenido que no se les ha encargado la investigación de Peña. "Puedo confirmarle que son otras agencias de investigación criminal las que están llevando este caso donde podría estar vinculada ella", dijo Ángel Murillo, director de la ATIC. Por su parte, el ministro de Seguridad, Gerzon Velásquez, negó que el asesinato de McNeil estuviera vinculado por su rol como testigo protegido de Peña. El pasado 7 de septiembre inició el juicio contra los Delta Teams , red acusada de trata de personas y pornografía infantil. Las investigaciones también apuntan que esta estructura criminal está vinculada con la desaparición de Peña, pero aún no han sido acusados formalmente por esta causa.
data.translatedTitle: "Do not trust the MP": new video by Dereck McNeil on the Angie Peña case
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- A new video recorded by Dereck McNeil, a protected witness in the case of Angie Peña who was murdered, has recently circulated, in which he warns anyone who wants to testify not to trust the authorities of the Public Ministry (MP). At the beginning of the audiovisual material, McNeil reported that he was taken to a private cafeteria in San Pedro Sula to meet with the head of the Technical Criminal Investigation Agency (ATIC) and "someone from drug trafficking" (without specifying whether it was an agent from the Directorate of Fight Against Drug Trafficking -DLCN- or another entity). "What they are interested in is drug trafficking information to sell. They burn themselves. That's where they come and make drug deals because that person offers them information in exchange for protection, money and all that," said McNeil. He described that the ATIC was "very corrupt" and that he decided to document his testimonies in videos, foreseeing the scenario that he was dead. "I'm going to tell you one thing: the protected witnesses, do not trust the Public Ministry anymore. The Public Ministry is full of corruption and as long as this continues, it is useless. The prosecution is rubbish. Those are false promises," he added, suggesting that the protected witnesses also not trust the Police Investigation Directorate (DPI) or the ATIC, calling them "liars." On the contrary, he recommended that they better turn to certified people from the United States Embassy in Honduras "or better not to speak. Stay silent because if you speak, they will always kill you. In my case, they wanted to kill me, they intimidated me." "All the people, know it. I was a person who wanted to help a cause and rather I ended up being the criminal's criminal. Imagine! Please, to all the people who see this video, be very careful. This is not something that is false," he asserted. Likewise, he stated that he would "try many things", an act that he was unable to achieve when he was gunned down on August 17 in Roatán, Bay Islands. Concluding the video, McNeil assured that the ATIC defended drug traffickers with arrest warrants. He then declared that if you wanted to become the head of the ATIC, you had to dedicate yourself to drug trafficking. "If they are prosecuted, it is because they did not arrive at the correct price, right? If not, dad, you continue giving drugs and you give their percentage to ATIC," he commented. After McNeil's death, several videos of him have been released in which he denounced corruption and collusion on the part of the ATIC in the case of Angie Peña, a young woman who has been missing since January 2022. However, the ATIC has maintained that they have not been entrusted with the investigation of Peña. "I can confirm that other criminal investigation agencies are carrying out this case where she could be linked," said Ángel Murillo, director of the ATIC. For his part, Security Minister Gerzon Velásquez denied that McNeil's murder was linked to his role as a protected witness for Peña. On September 7, the trial against the Delta Teams, a network accused of human trafficking and child pornography, began. Investigations also indicate that this criminal structure is linked to Peña's disappearance, but they have not yet been formally charged for this reason.

data.title: Declaran alerta amarilla y verde para municipios de Santa Bárbara por lluvias
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La Secretaría de Gestión de Riesgos y Contingencias (Copeco) declaró alerta amarilla y alerta verde para los municipios de Santa Bárbara debido a las lluvias intensas que han caído en este departamento en las últimas horas. La alerta amarilla aplica para Las Vegas, mientras que el resto de los 27 municipios permanecerán bajo alerta verde. Ambos estados de alerta entraron en vigor a partir de la noche del jueves 17 de septiembre y se mantendrán por 24 horas. En el caso de Las Vegas, Copeco indicó que se han reportado inundaciones, crecida de ríos y otras afectaciones que han obligado a familias a tener que evacuar sus viviendas. Bajo este escenario, Copeco ha instado a la población a evitar cruzar ríos, riachuelos, quebradas y otros caudales cuyas corrientes estén crecidas y limpiar tragantes y alcantarillas para evitar inundaciones. De igual forma, hizo un llamado de evacuación a los pobladores que residen cerca de ríos y quebradas, así como a aquellas personas que viven en sectores vulnerables a deslaves, derrumbes y hundimientos. El Centro Nacional de Estudios Atmosféricos, Oceanográficos y Sísmicos (Cenaos) informó que en las próximas horas habrán lluvias y chubascos en las regiones del norte, centro, oriente, sur y suroccidente del país; esto producto de una vaguada en nivel de superficie y la brisa proveniente del océano Pacífico. Cabe recordar que en esta semana las precipitaciones han sido mayores en la zona norte de Honduras, siendo una de las zonas más afectadas el municipio de Santa Cruz de Yojoa (Cortés) , donde se reportaron inundaciones y familias damnificadas. Francisco Argeñal, director de Cenaos, señaló que para este fin de semana se pronostican mayores precipitaciones que se estarían extendiendo hasta el lunes 21 de septiembre. Estas lluvias se esperan en las zonas del sur, centro, suroriente y suroccidente. Asimismo, recordó que "en la zona noroccidental estoy viendo casi todos los días, o día por medio, por lo menos hace más de un mes precipitaciones. También hemos tenido lluvias en el departamento de Colón, Atlántida, el norte de Yoro, Cortés y norte de Santa Bárbara”. Argeñal recomendó a la población a tomar precauciones ya que las lluvias podrían estar acompañadas de actividad eléctrica, fuertes vientos y granizo en algunas localidades.
data.translatedTitle: Yellow and green alert declared for municipalities of Santa Bárbara due to rain
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The Secretariat of Risk and Contingency Management (Copeco) declared a yellow alert and a green alert for the municipalities of Santa Bárbara due to the intense rains that have fallen in this department in the last few hours. The yellow alert applies to Las Vegas, while the rest of the 27 municipalities will remain under green alert. Both alert states came into effect on the night of Thursday, September 17, and will remain in effect for 24 hours. In the case of Las Vegas, Copeco indicated that flooding, river flooding and other impacts have been reported that have forced families to have to evacuate their homes. Under this scenario, Copeco has urged the population to avoid crossing rivers, streams, ravines and other flows whose currents are swollen and to clean gutters and sewers to avoid flooding. Likewise, he called for evacuation to residents who live near rivers and streams, as well as those who live in sectors vulnerable to landslides, landslides and subsidence. The National Center for Atmospheric, Oceanographic and Seismic Studies (Cenaos) reported that in the next few hours there will be rain and showers in the northern, central, eastern, southern and southwestern regions of the country; This is the product of a trough at the surface level and the breeze coming from the Pacific Ocean. It is worth remembering that this week the rainfall has been greater in the northern part of Honduras, with one of the most affected areas being the municipality of Santa Cruz de Yojoa (Cortés), where flooding and affected families were reported. Francisco Argeñal, director of Cenaos, pointed out that greater rainfall is forecast for this weekend that would last until Monday, September 21. These rains are expected in the southern, central, southeastern and southwest areas. Likewise, he recalled that "in the northwestern area I am seeing rainfall almost every day, or every other day, for at least more than a month. We have also had rain in the department of Colón, Atlántida, the north of Yoro, Cortés and the north of Santa Bárbara." Argeñal recommended the population to take precautions since the rains could be accompanied by electrical activity, strong winds and hail in some locations.

data.title: Cinco pseudomedios concentran casi la mitad de los bulos difundidos por estas cuentas
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Si los 142 bulos difundidos por pseudomedios entre enero y julio de 2026 se colocaran uno junto al otro, la desinformación parecería repartida entre decenas de nombres. Pero al ordenar los datos por frecuencia, esa dispersión comienza a desaparecer. Esos 142 contenidos forman parte de un universo de 393 bulos analizados por EH Verifica y LA PRENSA Verifica durante siete meses. La primera entrega de esta investigación estableció que el 36.1% había sido difundido por cuentas que utilizan nombres, diseños, logotipos o formatos similares a los de medios de comunicación. Ahora, al mirar dentro de esos 142 casos, aparece otro patrón: más de seis de cada diez publicaciones no corresponden a apariciones aisladas. De los contenidos identificados, 89 —el 62.7%— fueron difundidos por pseudomedios que aparecieron dos o más veces durante el período analizado. Los otros 53 registros, el 37.3%, correspondieron a cuentas detectadas una sola vez. La nueva revisión permite observar algo que el dato global no mostraba: no todos los pseudomedios tuvieron el mismo peso ni la desinformación estuvo distribuida de manera uniforme. A medida que se reduce el universo, la concentración se vuelve más evidente. Cinco nombres reúnen 62 publicaciones. Son el 43.7% de todos los bulos atribuidos a pseudomedios durante el período analizado. Dicho de otra manera: por cada diez contenidos falsos o engañosos difundidos por este tipo de cuentas, más de cuatro salieron de ese pequeño grupo. Y dentro de esos cinco hay uno que se distancia del resto. NoticiasDigitalhn acumuló 28 contenidos falsos o engañosos. La cifra representa el 19.7% de los 142 casos y equivale, por sí sola, a casi uno de cada cinco bulos difundidos por pseudomedios. De los 28 casos identificados, 26 fueron calificados como falsos y dos como engañosos. Después aparece una caída considerable. Libertad Digital registró 11 publicaciones; Señor Ortografia, 10; Jc Madrid, siete; y Espacio Democrático HN, seis. Los cuatro suman 34. NoticiasDigitalhn, por sí sola, acumuló 28. Así, cinco pseudomedios concentran 62 de los 142 registros, mientras el resto se distribuye entre decenas de nombres con una presencia considerablemente menor. Por debajo de ese grupo, la frecuencia comienza a fragmentarse. Honduras Sin Filtros apareció cuatro veces. MEGA Honduras, Pescadores del Sur y Agenda Total registraron tres casos cada uno. Después aparecen cuentas con dos registros y, finalmente, el grupo de apariciones únicas. El patrón dibuja una especie de pirámide: pocos pseudomedios en la parte superior concentran una porción considerable de los bulos; hacia la base, el número de nombres aumenta, pero disminuye su frecuencia individual. Los 89 casos de reincidencia representan casi dos tercios de los 142 contenidos. La proporción permite establecer una diferencia entre presencia y recurrencia. Identificar decenas de pseudomedios muestra que el fenómeno está disperso entre numerosas cuentas; determinar que el 62.7% de los contenidos provino de cuentas que aparecieron repetidamente permite advertir que, dentro de esa dispersión, existen focos recurrentes. Los datos tampoco permiten afirmar que cada publicación haya sido creada originalmente por el pseudomedio que la difundió. Una misma desinformación puede saltar entre cuentas y plataformas. Lo que registra el análisis es la presencia reiterada de determinados nombres dentro de los contenidos sometidos a verificación. Ese matiz es relevante: el estudio mide difusión identificada, no necesariamente autoría de los bulos. Pero la reincidencia deja otra pregunta abierta. Publicar más veces no significa necesariamente llegar más lejos. Facebook domina cuando la medición se hace por cantidad. De las 142 publicaciones, 121 circularon en esa plataforma: aproximadamente 85 de cada 100 registros. TikTok aparece muy lejos, con 15, y X apenas registra seis. Si el análisis terminara allí, Facebook parecería concentrar prácticamente todo el fenómeno. Las métricas de circulación cuentan otra parte de la historia. Las 121 publicaciones de Facebook acumularon al menos 16,229 compartidos. Las 15 de TikTok registraron 529,346 visualizaciones. Y las seis de X superaron, juntas, los dos millones: 2,052,703 visualizaciones. La relación se invierte. X representa únicamente el 4.2% de las publicaciones analizadas, pero sus seis registros consiguieron una exposición que supera ampliamente las visualizaciones acumuladas por los 15 contenidos identificados en TikTok. Entre ambas plataformas, 21 publicaciones sumaron 2,582,049 visualizaciones. No es posible sumar ese resultado con los 16,229 compartidos de Facebook como si se tratara de una sola medida de alcance. Una visualización y un compartido representan acciones distintas y las plataformas utilizan metodologías diferentes para contabilizarlas. Tampoco dos millones de visualizaciones equivalen necesariamente a dos millones de personas. Un mismo usuario puede visualizar una publicación más de una vez y la métrica no permite establecer cuántos creyeron, rechazaron o simplemente observaron el contenido. Pero el contraste permite advertir algo: frecuencia y circulación no son sinónimos. Una plataforma puede reunir la mayoría de los contenidos identificados mientras otra, con apenas un puñado de publicaciones, concentra millones de visualizaciones. La primera entrega permitió dimensionar cuánto pesaban los pseudomedios dentro de los 393 bulos analizados entre enero y julio: casi cuatro de cada diez. Al observar únicamente esos 142 registros, aparece una segunda capa. Primero, 89 fueron reincidencias. Después, 62 se concentran en cinco pseudomedios. Y, finalmente, 28 corresponden a uno solo. La secuencia —142, 89, 62, 28— muestra cómo un fenómeno aparentemente disperso se concentra conforme se examina quién está detrás de las publicaciones. Los 142 bulos, entonces, no cuentan 142 historias independientes. Detrás de buena parte de ellos vuelven a aparecer los mismos nombres. La desinformación parece dispersa cuando se observa publicación por publicación; al seguir quién la difunde, la concentración emerge. El alcance agrega otra dimensión. Los pseudomedios que más veces aparecen no necesariamente son los únicos que consiguen mayor exposición: una publicación puede ser apenas una entre 142 y, aun así, alcanzar cientos de miles de pantallas. La reincidencia permite saber quiénes vuelven a aparecer. Las visualizaciones y los compartidos permiten comenzar a medir hasta dónde llegan.
data.translatedTitle: Five pseudomedia accounts for almost half of the hoaxes spread by these accounts
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- If the 142 hoaxes spread by pseudomedia between January and July 2026 were placed side by side, the misinformation would seem to be distributed among dozens of names. But when you sort the data by frequency, that dispersion begins to disappear. These 142 contents are part of a universe of 393 hoaxes analyzed by EH Verifica and LA PRENSA Verifica for seven months. The first installment of this investigation established that 36.1% had been spread by accounts that use names, designs, logos or formats similar to those of media outlets. Now, when looking within those 142 cases, another pattern appears: more than six out of ten publications do not correspond to isolated appearances. Of the content identified, 89 – 62.7% – were disseminated by pseudomedia that appeared two or more times during the period analyzed. The other 53 records, 37.3%, corresponded to accounts detected only once. The new review allows us to observe something that the global data did not show: not all pseudomedia had the same weight nor was the misinformation distributed uniformly. As the universe shrinks, concentration becomes more evident. Five names bring together 62 publications. They are 43.7% of all hoaxes attributed to pseudomedia during the period analyzed. In other words: for every ten false or misleading content spread by this type of accounts, more than four came from that small group. And within those five there is one that distances itself from the rest. NoticiasDigitalhn accumulated 28 false or misleading content. The figure represents 19.7% of the 142 cases and is equivalent, by itself, to almost one in five hoaxes spread by pseudomedia. Of the 28 cases identified, 26 were classified as false and two as misleading. Then a considerable drop appears. Libertad Digital registered 11 publications; Mr. Spelling, 10; Jc Madrid, seven; and Espacio Democrático HN, six. The four add up to 34. NoticiasDigitalhn, by itself, accumulated 28. Thus, five pseudomedia outlets concentrate 62 of the 142 records, while the rest is distributed among dozens of names with a considerably smaller presence. Below that group, the frequency begins to fragment. Honduras Sin Filtros appeared four times. MEGA Honduras, Pescadores del Sur and Agenda Total registered three cases each. Then there are accounts with two records and, finally, the group of single occurrences. The pattern draws a kind of pyramid: a few pseudomedia at the top concentrate a considerable portion of the hoaxes; Towards the base, the number of names increases, but their individual frequency decreases. The 89 cases of recidivism represent almost two thirds of the 142 contents. The proportion allows us to establish a difference between presence and recurrence. Identifying dozens of pseudomedia shows that the phenomenon is dispersed among numerous accounts; Determining that 62.7% of the content came from accounts that appeared repeatedly allows us to notice that, within this dispersion, there are recurring foci. The data also does not allow us to affirm that each publication was originally created by the pseudomedia that disseminated it. The same misinformation can jump between accounts and platforms. What the analysis records is the repeated presence of certain names within the contents subject to verification. This nuance is relevant: the study measures identified diffusion, not necessarily authorship of the hoaxes. But the recidivism leaves another question open. Posting more times does not necessarily mean going further. Facebook dominates when measurement is done by quantity. Of the 142 publications, 121 circulated on that platform: approximately 85 out of every 100 records. TikTok appears very far away, with 15, and X barely registers six. If the analysis ended there, Facebook would seem to concentrate practically the entire phenomenon. Circulation metrics tell another part of the story. The 121 Facebook posts accumulated at least 16,229 shares. The 15 on TikTok recorded 529,346 views. And the six of X together exceeded two million: 2,052,703 views. The relationship is reversed. X represents only 4.2% of the publications analyzed, but its six records achieved exposure that far exceeds the views accumulated by the 15 content identified on TikTok. Between both platforms, 21 publications totaled 2,582,049 views. It is not possible to add this result with the 16,229 Facebook shares as if it were a single reach measure. A view and a share represent different actions and the platforms use different methodologies to account for them. Nor do two million views necessarily equal two million people. The same user can view a publication more than once and the metric does not allow us to establish how many believed, rejected or simply observed the content. But the contrast allows us to notice something: frequency and circulation are not synonymous. One platform can bring together the majority of the identified content while another, with just a handful of publications, concentrates millions of views. The first installment allowed us to measure how much pseudomedia weighed within the 393 hoaxes analyzed between January and July: almost four out of every ten. By looking at just those 142 records, a second layer appears. First, 89 were repeat offenses. Then, 62 are concentrated in five pseudomedia. And, finally, 28 correspond to only one. The sequence —142, 89, 62, 28— shows how an apparently dispersed phenomenon becomes concentrated as we examine who is behind the publications. The 142 hoaxes, then, do not tell 142 independent stories. Behind many of them the same names appear again. The misinformation appears scattered when viewed post by post; By following who spreads it, concentration emerges. Scope adds another dimension. The pseudomedia that appears the most times are not necessarily the only ones that get the most exposure: a publication can be just one in 142 and still reach hundreds of thousands of screens. Recidivism allows us to know who reappears. Views and shares allow you to begin to measure how far they go.

data.title: RAHA NAGU RABA! ⟩ Teletegijate rahakott luubi all: Margna firmad teenisid üle 300 000 euro puhaskasumit
data.description: Eesti tuntud teletegijate ettevõtete värsked aruanded paljastavad suuri kasumeid, järske käibelangusi ja ühe märgilise pöörde kahjumist plussi. Vaata, kelle firma lõpetas aasta kõige priskema tulemusega.

data.title: Jäledad smuutid ja kotid peas metsa: miks noortele rebaste ristimine ikkagi meeldib?
data.description: Ehkki rebaste ristimine ehk retsimine koolides tundub olevat aastatega kammitsetumaks muutunud, pole piinlikud ülesanded ja salapärased metsaretked kuhugi kadunud. Ometi ütlevad noored, et see kõik aitab uude kooli sisse elada.
data.translatedTitle: Disgusting smoothies and bags on your head: why do young people still like christening foxes?
data.translatedDescription: Although the baptism of foxes in schools seems to have become more scandalous over the years, the embarrassing tasks and mysterious forest trips have not disappeared. However, the young people say that all this helps them settle into the new school.

data.title: Karel Tilga lõpetas Talence’is avapäeva 13. kohal
data.description: Ainsa Eesti kümnevõistlejana alustas Karel Tilga reedel Prantsusmaal Talence'is traditsioonilist mitmevõistlust, mille avapäeva lõpetas pärast viite ala 13. kohal. Postimees annab võistlusest jooksvalt ülevaate.
data.translatedTitle: Karel Tilga finished the opening day in Talence in 13th place
data.translatedDescription: As the only Estonian decathlete, Karel Tilga started the traditional all-around competition on Friday in Talence, France, and finished the opening day in 13th place after the fifth event. Postimees gives a running overview of the competition.

data.title: USA keelas teist aastat järjest Palestiina ametnikele ÜRO peaassambleele sõitmise
data.description: USA välisministeerium teatas, et keeldus taas Palestiina omavalitsuse ja Palestiina Vabastusorganisatsiooni (PLO) ametnikele viisade väljastamisest enne järgmisel nädalal New Yorgis algavat ÜRO peaassambleed.
data.translatedTitle: For the second year in a row, the US has banned Palestinian officials from traveling to the UN General Assembly
data.translatedDescription: The US State Department announced that it has again denied visas to officials of the Palestinian Authority and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) ahead of next week's UN General Assembly in New York.

data.title: Teed kohvist pausi? 4 head jooki, mida selle asemel proovida
data.description: Hommikukohv on paljude jaoks sama oluline rituaal kui äratuskella kinni vajutamine. Ent kui kohv paneb südame puperdama, tekitab rahutust või hakkab õhtust und häirima, võib olla aeg proovida midagi muud.
data.translatedTitle: Taking a coffee break? 4 great drinks to try instead
data.translatedDescription: For many, morning coffee is as important a ritual as pressing the alarm clock. But if coffee makes your heart flutter, makes you restless, or starts to disturb your night's sleep, it may be time to try something else.

data.title: Kas Eestis peetakse vägivaldset käitumist normaalseks? Stuudios on Hannaliisa Uusma
data.description: Eestis on väga palju lähisuhtevägivalda, mis tähendab, et ka meie lapsed kasvavad üles vägivaldsetes kodudes. Miks inimesed vaikivad ja abi ei küsi, sellest räägime Pühapäeva stuudios muusiku ja president Kaljulaidi fondi vägivalla ennetuse suuna juhi Hannaliisa Uusmaga.
data.translatedTitle: Is violent behavior considered normal in Estonia? Hannaliisa Uusma is in the studio
data.translatedDescription: There is a lot of intimate partner violence in Estonia, which means that our children also grow up in violent homes. Why people are silent and don't ask for help is what we talk about in the Pühäpää studio with Hannaliisa Uusma, a musician and head of the violence prevention department of the President Kaljulaid Foundation.

data.title: «Eesti on liiga väike, et neid kogemusi kaotada.» Rehemaa näeb Eesti suusatipus treeneriainest
data.description: Eesti meeste murdmaasuusakoondise esinumber Alvar Johannes Alev läheb veebruaris vastu karjääri viiendale MMile. See võib, kuid ei pruugi jääda tema viimaseks sportlasena. Praegune koondise juht Aivar Rehemaa usub, et tema teadmistest ja kogemustest oleks tulevikus Eesti suusaspordi arendamisel kõvasti kasu. Alev ei ütleks sellisest võimalusest ära.
data.translatedTitle: "Estonia is too small to lose these experiences." Rehemaa sees coaching material at the top of Estonian skiing
data.translatedDescription: Alvar Johannes Alev, number one of the Estonian men's cross-country skiing team, will compete in the fifth World Cup of his career in February. It may or may not be his last as an athlete. The current head of the team, Aivar Rehemaa, believes that his knowledge and experience would greatly benefit the development of Estonian skiing in the future. The town would not refuse such an opportunity.

data.title: KUULA INTERVJUUD ⟩ Kas sinu iseloom on juba sündides geenides? Rohkem, kui arvame, kuid siiski vähem, kui karta võiks
data.description: Miks on üks inimene ärevam, teine seltskondlikum ja kolmas erakordselt kohusetundlik? Seni oli teada, et osa neist erinevustest on seotud pärilikkusega, kuid konkreetsed geneetilise pusle tükid olid suuresti puudu.
data.translatedTitle: LISTEN TO INTERVIEWS ⟩ Is your character already in your genes at birth? More than we think, but still less than one might fear
data.translatedDescription: Why is one person more anxious, another more sociable, and a third exceptionally conscientious? Until now, it was known that some of these differences were related to heredity, but the specific pieces of the genetic puzzle were largely missing.

data.title: Avati Eesti Kunstnike Liidu toetusoksjoni näitus, odavaima teose alghinnaks vaid 100 eurot
data.description: 8.–10. oktoobrini korraldab Eesti Kunstnike Liit (EKL) erakorralise kunstioksjoni, kus läheb enampakkumisele 162 tööd. Oksjonil on esindatud nii liidu kunstikogusse kuuluvad teosed kui ka kunstnikelt värskete annetustena saadud teosed. Näitusega, mis ulatub maalist ja graafikast kuni foto, skulptuursete objektide ja tekstiilikunstini, saab tutvuda ARSi kunstilinnakus 18. septembrist kuni 7. oktoobrini.
data.translatedTitle: The exhibition of the support auction of the Estonian Artists' Union was opened, the starting price of the cheapest work was only 100 euros
data.translatedDescription: 8-10 until October, the Estonian Artists Union (EKL) will organize an extraordinary art auction, where 162 works will be auctioned. The auction features both works belonging to the Union's art collection and works received as fresh donations from artists. The exhibition, which ranges from painting and graphics to photography, sculptural objects and textile art, can be seen at the ARS Art Campus from September 18 to October 7.

data.title: RAINER SAKS ⟩ Putin tahaks mobilisatsiooni vältida, kuid kas see tal ka õnnestub
data.description: USA president allkirjastas eile USA Kongressis äsja vastu võetud uue Venemaad piirava sanktsioonide eelnõu ning seadus peaks rakenduma kohe. USA välisministeerium andis samal aja loa müüa Ukraina armeele 2,68 miljardi dollari eest õhutõrjevahendeid, mille hulgas küll ei ole Patriot-süsteemide rakette, kirjutab julgeolekuekspert Rainer Saks.
data.translatedTitle: RAINER SAKS ⟩ Putin would like to avoid mobilization, but will he succeed?
data.translatedDescription: Yesterday, the US President signed the new sanctions bill that was just passed by the US Congress to restrict Russia, and the law should be implemented immediately. At the same time, the US Department of State authorized the sale of air defense equipment to the Ukrainian army for $2.68 billion, which does not include Patriot system missiles, writes security expert Rainer Saks.

data.title: OLLI NURMI ⟩ 1991. aasta sügisel ütles Putin soomlastele, et Nõukogude sõdurid jäävad Eestisse veel pikaks ajaks
data.description: Eesti oli Vladimir Putini «geopoliitilise katastroofiga» lähedalt seotud ja tal oli teisigi põhjusi eestlaste vastu vimma pidada. Kuid üllataval kombel oli tema poliitiliseks eeskujuks üks 1990. aastate Venemaa tuntumaid demokraate Anatoli Sobtšak, kirjutab Helsingi ülikoolis Eesti iseseisvuse taastamisest doktoriväitekirja kaitsnud Soome diplomaat Olli Nurmi.
data.translatedTitle: OLLI NURMI ⟩ In the fall of 1991, Putin told Finns that Soviet soldiers would remain in Estonia for a long time
data.translatedDescription: Estonia was closely related to Vladimir Putin's "geopolitical catastrophe" and had other reasons to hold a grudge against Estonians. But surprisingly, his political role model was one of Russia's best-known democrats of the 1990s, Anatoli Sobčak, writes Olli Nurmi, a Finnish diplomat who defended his doctoral thesis on the restoration of Estonian independence at the University of Helsinki.

data.title: Päästekoer Hugo Boss leidis kadunud naise vaid 40 minutiga: «Tohutu kergendus, et ta oli elus»
data.description: Alles paar aastat päästetöös osalenud saksa lambakoer Hugo Boss aitas augusti lõpus leida Türi hooldekodust kadunud naise. Hugo jälgis inimese lõhnarada ning leidis naise metsatukast kõigest 40 minutiga. Koera omaniku ja juhi Kaidi Juuriku sõnul oli see hetk täis kirjeldamatut kergendust ja rõõmu.
data.translatedTitle: Rescue dog Hugo Boss found the missing woman in just 40 minutes: "Immense relief that she was alive"
data.translatedDescription: At the end of August, German shepherd Hugo Boss, who had only been involved in rescue work for a few years, helped to find a missing woman from the Türi nursing home. Hugo followed the person's scent trail and found the woman in the grove in just 40 minutes. According to Kaidi Juurik, the owner and manager of the dog, this moment was full of indescribable relief and joy.

data.title: Europiečius „gelbsti“ rusiškas dyzelinas? Viena autobuso nuotrauka virto propagandos istorija
data.description: Rusijos propagandos kanalai paskelbė atradę dar vieną tariamą ES sankcijų paradoksą: tarp Kaliningrado ir Vokietijos kursuojantis autobusas esą Rusijoje prisipila pilną baką pigaus dyzelino ir per vieną kartą sutaupo apie tūkstantį eurų. Iš pavienės autobuso nuotraukos mėginama padaryti išvadą, kad sankcijos tuština europiečių pinigines, o juos „gelbsti“ rusiški degalai.
data.translatedTitle: Europeans are "saved" by Russian diesel? One photo of the bus turned into a propaganda story
data.translatedDescription: Russian propaganda channels announced that they discovered another alleged paradox of EU sanctions: a bus running between Kaliningrad and Germany allegedly fills up a full tank of cheap diesel in Russia and saves about a thousand euros in one go. From a single photo of a bus, an attempt is made to conclude that sanctions are emptying the wallets of Europeans, and they are being "saved" by Russian fuel.

data.title: Romanian ethnic minority and economic cooperation among chief concerns regionally, president says during C8 summit in Ukraine
data.description: The initiative brought together the eight countries crossed by the Carpathian Mountains: Austria, the Czech Republic, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Hungary and Ukraine. Among the objectives of the initiative were capitalizing on the region’s economic potential, attracting investments, protecting cultural and natural heritage, and developing cooperation between states. Nicușor Dan explained that the meeting aimed to better capitalize on the potential of the Carpathian region and strengthen ties between the countries in this area. “It is a summit that is trying to capitalize on the Carpathian region, and it is important for us from several perspectives. First of all, to build neighborhood relations. Obviously, we are interested in the Romanian minority here. The better connected we are, the closer they will be and the more they will be able to express their identity,” Nicușor Dan said before the summit, cited by Economedia . The president also emphasized the economic opportunities that closer cooperation between the states in the region can bring. According to Nicușor Dan, developing connections between the states in the Carpathian region could contribute both to attracting investments and to creating common economic opportunities. The president also spoke about the tourism potential of the Carpathian area in Romania. After the summit, the president explained that Romania hosts half of the Carpathian mountain range. "The Carpathian countries need to cooperate better to build roads and border crossing points, to strengthen energy connections, to promote tourism and economic and cultural exchanges, to protect nature, and to attract investments. I supported the need for an integrated approach to investments and projects that reach local communities," he said in a post on Facebook . Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelensky chaired the inaugural summit of the “Carpathian 8” initiative. “The Carpathians are not only beautiful, but they’re also an important part of the strength of our countries and of Europe. The mountains do not divide, but unite regions through major Carpathian transport and logistics routes. We developed strong cross-border trade and energy links here, and they are critical for our countries,” the Ukrainian president said. https://x.com/ZelenskyyUa/status/2100896368432746873 He added that the goal is “to create a new solid framework for cooperation at EU level” in areas such as security, energy, and expanding logistics and cross-border economic cooperation. Polish prime minister Donald Tusk was also at the summit and posted on X a photo of himself alongside Zelensky and the Ukrainian president’s wife, Olena. https://x.com/donaldtusk/status/2100872992066576499/photo/1

data.title: North Bucharest Investments exceeds €34.5 million in transactions since ANCPI restarted operations
data.description: North Bucharest Investments' latest figures point to a dynamic start to the autumn season for Bucharest's residential market, with sustained demand from both end-users and investors. North Bucharest Investments (NBI) has exceeded €34.5 million in transactions since ANCPI resumed operations, achieving this volume in less than a month . During this period, the company brokered more than 210 transactions , with an average value of approximately €164,000 per property , as the market quickly returned to a sustained pace of activity following this summer's administrative disruption. Beyond the natural catch-up effect of transactions that had been temporarily delayed, the momentum of recent weeks points to active demand and available capital , in a market where buyers are increasingly informed, selective and focused on both the timing and quality of their acquisitions. The premium segment accounted for some of the most significant transactions brokered by North Bucharest Investments during this period. The largest transaction reached €1.65 million, excluding VAT , for a penthouse located in Bucharest's emerging new downtown around Fabrica de Glucoza , an area increasingly establishing itself as one of the capital's new hotspots for premium residential demand. Its connectivity to Floreasca, Aviatiei and Pipera, proximity to Bucharest's major business hubs and the pace of new residential development have turned Fabrica de Glucoza into one of the city's most closely watched real estate corridors. A second major transaction, worth more than €1.4 million, excluding VAT , involved a penthouse in a boutique development in Floreasca, with direct lake views , in an area where the supply of truly premium properties remains limited. Together, the two acquisitions exceed €3 million , highlighting the continued flow of capital into the upper end of the residential market, particularly for rare properties where location, views, exclusivity and appreciation potential play a decisive role. One of the most visible shifts in the market is buyer behaviour. Decisions are increasingly research-driven, projects are being compared more carefully, and criteria such as entry price, location, developer track record, appreciation potential and resale liquidity have become central to the purchasing process. Buyers are more selective, but move quickly when they identify the right opportunity. Investors, in particular, are focusing on projects and micro-locations with strong appreciation potential. "The figures from recent weeks show us a market that is far more active than general perception might suggest. More than €34.5 million and over 210 transactions in less than a month demonstrate that capital is available and there is a clear appetite for acquisitions. Buyers are, however, much more selective about where they place their money. We are seeing strong interest in well-positioned developments and, above all, in properties with a clear value proposition over the medium and long term." said Vlad Musteata, CEO of North Bucharest Investments. The results come as North Bucharest Investments works with a network of more than 80 developers and a portfolio of over 100 residential projects , with a strong presence across the key development areas of northern Bucharest. Demand is diversified, ranging from compact units acquired for investment purposes to larger homes for end-users and premium properties or penthouses priced above €1 million. This diversification reflects a market where different types of capital are targeting different products, while sharing the same focus on location, quality and long-term value. The restart of ANCPI operations provided the trigger for a volume of temporarily delayed transactions to move forward, but the pace of activity since then suggests more than a simple catch-up effect . Technology is also becoming increasingly visible in NBI's business results: approximately 30% of the company's transaction volume during the period analysed was generated by clients acquired through the North Bucharest app , Romania's first AI-assisted real estate platform. For NBI, the figures reinforce a clear direction: an active market, an increasingly connected buyer and a business model where technology and real estate advisory work together. data.title: European Commission approves plan to unblock Romanian sheep and goat exports
data.description: The strategic document drawn up by ANSVSA experts was approved, without amendments, by all 27 representatives of EU member states in the specialized committee within the European Commission. “The approval of this plan represents an important step towards resuming sheep and goat exports from Romania, as it paves the way for a reassessment of the epidemiological status at national level,” the institution said in a press statement . Before the resumption of deliveries to EU member states and third countries, the EC still has to adopt an official direction to establish the special vaccination status for high-risk counties and officially recognize the rest of Romania’s territory as disease-free. Destination countries will also have to validate the new sanitary-veterinary conditions. Finally, Romania will have to implement immunization on the ground, an operation directly supported by the European Executive, which is providing Romania, free of charge, with a contingent of 1.3 million doses of vaccine. According to ANSVSA, Romania anticipated these technical requirements and secured strategic foreign markets in advance. “So far, our country has already signed six international treaties for exports under vaccination conditions with major trading partners: Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Morocco, Tunisia, Israel and Libya. At the same time, seven other similar agreements are under advanced negotiations, guaranteeing a broad range of commercial outlets as soon as the new epidemiological status becomes active,” ANSVSA management said. The national vaccination strategy validated by the Commission will be applied differently, depending on the level of regional epidemiological risk. In maximum-risk zones like Tulcea and Constanta Counties, the full immunization scheme will be applied through the simultaneous administration of vaccines against Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR) and Sheep and Goat Pox (SGP). From this special logistical zone, exports will be carried out exclusively to third countries that expressly accept imports from territories where vaccination is practiced. Romanian authorities had to slaughter approximately 19,000, representing 0.13% of the total estimated number of heads nationwide, to protect against the spread of PPR and SGP. “The action plan approved yesterday by the European Commission does not in any way affect exports of carcasses, milk or dairy products from Romania,” ANSVSA management said. Earlier this week, shepherds and farmers protested in front of the Romanian government headquarters against the blocking of sheep and goat exports, the slaughtering of animals, and unpaid compensation. The protest turned violent, and gendarmes used tear gas to disperse the crowds.
